【43】**HE panniculitis of lupus erythematosus， also called lupus profundus， and the panniculitis of scleroderma， sometimes termed morphea profundus， have many histologic features in common， namely， foci of fat necrosis within areas of foamy histiocytes and inflamma-tory-cell infiltrates， involvement of both lobules and septa by the inflamma-tory cells， and thickening and sclerosis of fibrous septa. Mononuclear cells predominate in the inflammatory-cell infiltrates， and plasma cells may be numerous； these infiltrates are often patchy， but may be situated predomi-nantly around blood vessels. In both diseases， there may be superficial and deep perivascular inflammatory-cell infiltrates in the dermis apart from the changes in the fat. Either condition may be devoid of changes at the dermo-epidermal junction. Foci of calcification may be present in either condition.**

【44】**The most important differences between these two inflammatory dis-eases is that the inflammatory-cell infiltrate in the subcutis of lupus profun-dus is predominantly lobular and is associated initially with serous atrophy of fat and later with hyalinized necrosis of fat. The inflammatory-cell infil-trate in the panniculitis of scleroderma tends to be septal， with nodular collections of inflammatory cells in contiguity with the fibrous septa and at the base of the dermis. In the panniculitis of lupus erythematosus， there may be all of the changes of discoid lupus erythematosus， namely， a thinned epidermis， vacuolar alteration alongthe basal layer of the epidermis， a thickened basement membrane， and mucin deposits and degeneration of collagen in the dermis. In the panniculitis of scleroderma， there may be the ypical dermal changes of scleroderma， namely， the collagen bundles， espe-cially in the lower one halfof the dermis， are markedly thickened， parallel to one another， andpacked together tightly.**

The panniculitis of lupus erythematosus may occur with or without any other manifestation of lupus erythematosus in the skin or other organs，and it may or may not be associated with serologic features of systemic disease. The lesions of lupus profundus are usually situated deep in the dermis and in the subcutis. Clinically， the skin may be completely normal upon inspec-tion， but it may also be reddened and scaly as in classic lesions of discoid lupus erythematosus. Some lesions may be depressed beneath the skin sur-face. A characteristic finding of lupus profundus is that it can be appreci-ated best by palpation. These lesions， seated deep in the skin， are rock hard and can usually be grasped firmly between the thumb and fingers. Most lesions of lupus profundus are distributed on the head and neck， but some may often be present on the upper part of the arms or on the buttocks. The majority of patients with lupus profundus have some of the serologic abnor-|删除0换行|malities noted in patients with systemnic lupus erythemnatosus， but few of these patients develop the latter disease.

【46】Interestingly， the lesions of lupus profundus respond poorly to injec-tions of corticosteroids intralesionally， in contrast to the response of lesions of discoid lupus erythematosus. After injection of corticosteroid intralesion-ally or after the trauma of biopsy， lesions of lupus profundus， which had heretofore been indolent， may enlarge rapidly and even ulcerate. Treatment with antimalarial medications in small doses often leads to dramatic reso-lution of these deep-seated lesions.

【47】The panniculitis of scleroderma is usually associated with sclerosis in the overlying dermis， hence the lesion clinically resembles a form of sclero-derma， either progressive systemic sclerosis or localized scleroderma (e.g.， morphea and linear). All of the several varieties of scleroderma are charac-terized during their active stages by panniculitis and an inflammatory-cell infiltrate. As the inflammatory-cell infiltrate wanes， the fibrous septa be-come widened by thick， sclerotic collagen bundles. The inflammatory changes are seen clinically as lilac rims that surround whitish zones of sclerosis， but that lilac color fades as the inflammatory-cell infiltrate lessens with age.

【48】One interesting type of scleroderma is fasciitis with eosinophilia or Schulman's syndrome. This entity is sometimes improperly termed cosino-philic fasciitis. Not only is the fasciitis not eosinophilic， but there may be no eosinophils in the infiltrate of inflammatory cells situated deep in the der-mis or subeutis or within the fascia. Most of the cells are lymphocytes and plasma cells. Some patients， however， are found to have increased numbers of circulating eosinophils. This rare syndrome is peculiar clinically in that it appears rapidly (within a few weeks)， follows extremes of exertion or trauma， affects large surface areas of the body， and responds well to admin-istration of systemic corticosteroids. At various stages of its evolution， fas-ciitis with eosinophils is indistinguishable from morphea clinically and his-topathologically. Despite its rapidly progressive pace and wide extent， this phenomenon， unlike other sclerodermas， may abate and leave the patient with little residual impairment.

【69】N bothgranuloma annulare and eruptive xan-thoma， there are histiocytes situated focally， mostly in the upper part of the dermis， sometimes in palisades， and sometimes as cells interposed as soli-tary units between collagen bundles. A lymphocytic infiltrate is present usu-ally around blood vessels， there are extracellular deposits of blue-staining， granular， and stringymaterial， and nuclear “dust”is often present. The epidermis is usually normal in these conditions. The major feature that distinguishes granuloma annulare is that the extracellular， granular， and stringy basophilic material is mucin (which can be proved by colloidal iron stain)， whereas the more amphophilic granular， stringy material in eruptive xanthoma is lipid (which does not stain with colloidal iron). In addition， granuloma annulare often has vasculitis of small blood vessels and altered collagen； eruptive xanthoma， which has plump foamy histiocytes， has no vasculitis and no altered collagen.

【70】Granuloma annulare tends to affect children andyoung adults， al-though patients of any age may develop the disease. Scattered individual papules andpapules in annular configuration are skin colored or only slightly yellowish and are asymptomatic. The dorsa of the hands， the fin-gers， feet， and extensor surfaces of arms and legs are areas of predilection， although any cutaneous site may be involved. An unusual widespread erup-tion of granuloma annulare may occur in middle-aged or elderly patients， often in those patients with diabetes mellitus. Lesions of granuloma annu-lare disappear in several months， even without treatment.

【71】Eruptive xanthomas are tiny， yelow papules on reddish bases. They tend to become confluent， to appear and disappear rapidly， and to occur in crops； they do not have a tendency to annular configuration. Lesions may develop on mucous membranes， especially those of the oral cavity. An un-derlying lipid abnormality is usually identified in patients with eruptive xanthoma， and that abnormality always includes hypertriglyceridemia. Hyperlipidemia type I is most common in association with eruptive xantho-mas， types Ⅳ and V are the next most common， and type III occurs least commonly. Patients with eruptive xanthomas may have signs and symp-toms other than of the cutaneous sort as a result of hypertriglyceridemia， such as hepatosplenomegaly， lipemia retinalis， abdominal pain， and pan-creatitis.

Granuloma annulare has no well-understood pathogenesis. Its seasonal peaks in the spring and fall suggest that it may be transmittable. Strong clinical histories and the presence of eosinophils episodically indicate that insect bites may induce some lesions of granuloma annulare. The condition|删除0换行|is sometimes provoked by sunlight as is evidenced by the distribution of the lesions. Other conditions may at times closely resemble granuloma annulare histologically， including eosinophilic cellulitis of Wells and the granuloma-tous vasculitis of Churg and Straus. Other palisaded granulomatous condi-tions in the differential diagnosis are necrobiosis lipoidica diabeticorum， rheumatoid nodule， gout， foreign body reaction， and Miescher’s granuloma of the face.**

【73】**All types of xanthomas share the deposition of excess lipid in the skin. Histologically， each condition has certain distinctive features. Eruptive xan-thomas are the only type with granular and stringy material between col-lagen bundles， located outside of histiocytes. Planar xanthomas， called xan-thelasma on the eyelids and palmaris or plantaris if on a palm or sole， have large lipid-laden foamy histiocytes arrayed along the paths of smal blood vessels. Tuberous or tumefactive xanthomas， termed tendinous if located near tendon sheaths， have large aggregations of foamy histiocytes that may extend deep into the subcutis， but have no perivascular arrangement.**

**ERFORATING folliculitis and elastosis perforans ser-|删除0换行|piginosa are conditions that have several histologic features in common， namely， epithelial channels through the epidermis； foci of suppuration at the bases of the channels that may contain altered fibers as well as degener-ated collagen， foci of granulomatous inflammation， including histiocytic giant cells， and fibrosis in the upper part of the dermis. Both within the epithelial channels and at their peripheries there are abnormally cornifying cells， neutrophils， fragments of neutrophil nuclei (nuclear "dust")， and eo-sinophilic-staining elastic fibers. Several features enable the two conditions to be distinguished from one another. The epithelial channel in perforating folliculitis is the infundibulum of a hair follicle； there are prominent suppu-ration， few elastic fibers within the channel， and but a single focus of patho-ogic abnormality in the biopsy specimen. In elastosis perforans serpiginosa， in contrast， the channel is formed not usually by a follicle but within the epidermis itself. There are multiple foci of pathologic changes， and there is marked alteration of the elastic tissue both outside of the channel and within it， where there are many thickened elastic fibers.

【8】**Perforating folliculitis is really a histologic concept and is practically never recognized for what it is clinically. The clinical diagnoses for these scattered， red， follicular papules range from insect bites to folliculitis. The eruption occurs mainly on the limbs of young adults and is usually more chronic than acute. The histologic feature of perforation through the follicu-lar wall by a focus of suppurative inflammation is most likely the result of a fortuitous biopsy at the point in time at which the damage to the epithelial wall， caused by the lysozomal enzymes of the neutrophils， combines with the mechanicalpressure of the collection of cclls within the follicular infun-dibulum to lead to rupture. At some point in time， probably all suppurative folliculitides could show these histologic features， and most of them do.**

【9】In elastosis perforans serpiginosa， there is an alteration of the elastic tissue unlike that seen in any other condition. Most affected patients are adolescents who develop crusted papules that tend to coalesce and that are arranged in arcuate， annular， or linear fashion. Usually， the lesions occur on the posterior or lateral parts of the neck， the cheeks， the antecubital fossae， or the upper parts of the legs. In nearly one half of cases of elastosisper-forans serpiginosa， the condition is associated with a separate ongoingcon-dition， such as pseudoxanthoma elasticum， the Ehlers-Danlos syndrome， Marfan's syndrome， osteogenesis imperfecta， or Down’s syndrome. Some-times， elastosis perforans serpiginosa is induced by penicillamine therapy. Most often， the clinician recognizes elastosis perforans serpiginosa for what it is grossly and performs a biopsy merely for confirmation.

【10】The classical histologic findings in elastosis perforans serpiginosa are the thickened， brightly eosinophilic， or slightly amphophilic elastic fibers within the lumina of the “perforating” epidermal channels. Many authors have noted the altered tinctorial qualities of the elastic fibers in the upper papillary dermis as well， but few have commented on the equally thickened and altered fibers found frequently in the middle and upper parts of the reticular dermis. In lesions of elastosis perforans serpiginosa that have becn induced by penicillamine， the elastic fibers are not only thickened， but also have corrugated or serrated borders. Stains for elastic tissue will demon-strate these alterations quite dramatically， but the changes are nearly equally apparent in sections stained with hematoxylin and eosin.

【11】The phenomenon ofperforationis visualized in a histologic snapshot， being the moment in time when an epithelium is breeched by altered mate-rial presumably from the dermis. Because that altered material is present above and below as well as within the epithelial channel， the presumption has been that it is being extruded by some “active” process. Some have termed this process， which they perceive to be common to all perforating diseases， transepidermal elimination. The pathophysiologic mechanisms of transepidermal elimination remain obscure， and the explanations proposed for this process are not supported by scientific evidence. At times，reason-able scenarios may be postulated for the sequence of events in perforating diseases， such as was presented here in the discussion concerning perforat-ing folliculitis. Some authors have argued that chondrodermatitis nodularis chronica helicis is a perforating disease， but numerous clinical and histo-logic features suggest that the changes result from persistent and repeated external trauma to the ear， analogous to that in picker’s and surfer’s nod-ules. In other conditions， such as pseudoxanthoma elasticum and the perfo-rating form of granuloma annulare， no cause is truly apparent and no ade-quate mechanistic explanation hasyet been deduced. Kyrle’s disease is probably nothing more than an uncommon variant of perforating folliculitis and is truly hyperkeratosis follicularis， parafollicularis bcing secondary to rupture of the infundibular portion of the follicle.

【56】We are grateful to the publishers， Elsevier， for the invitation to _produce a fourth edition of the Pocketbook of Differential Diagnosis._ The text has been updated and some further conditions added. Readers and reviewers also suggested that the addition of management of diseases would be helpful but this book is a manual of differential diagnosis； treatment of the various conditions is outside the scope of this book.

【77】**HOW TO USE THIS BOOK**

【78】**This book has been written in three sections： Clinical Presentations， Biochemical Presentations and Haematological Presentations.**

【79】In the Clinical Presentations section (Section A)， we have attempted to indicate the relative frequency of the conditions causing the various symptoms and signs by colour coding them in green， orange and red， according to whether they are considered common， occasional or rare， respectively.

【80】**A common cause of the symptom or sign**

【81】**Might occasionally give rise to the symptom or sign**

【82】**Will only rarely cause the symptom or sign**

【83】This has been no easy task (and indeed in the Biochemical Presentations and Haematological Presentations sections， we found it so difficult that we abandoned it) but we hope that it will indicate to readers whether they are dealing with a common， occasional or rare disorder. It is appreciated that some conditions may be common in the UK and rare in other parts of the world (and vice versa). Where this is the case， the appropriate colour coding is indicated in brackets， e.g. Campylobacter is a common cause of diarrhoea in the UK and therefore coded green but rare in tropical Africa and therefore coded red and in brackets. We have tried to indicate the importance of the condition， not only in causing a particular symptom or sign， but also in its overall incidence， e.g. diverticular disease is a common condition and is a common cause of pain in the left iliac fossa and is therefore coded green. It is only an occasional cause of large bowel obstruction and in this context， is coded orange.

【84】At the end of each chapter， the reader will find a box containing either what we consider to be important learning points， or indicating symptoms and signs suggestive of significant pathology that require urgent action.

【175】Abdominal pain is an extremely common presenting symptom. The pain may be acute (sudden onset) or chronic (lasting for more than a few days or presenting intermittently). The causes of abdominal pain are legion and the list below contains some of the more common causes but is not intended to be comprehensive.

【246】**HISTORY**

【247】零碎段删除-1:<u>**Age**</u>

【248】Certain conditions are more likely to occur in certain age groups， e.g. mesenteric adenitis in children， diverticular disease in the elderly.

【249】**Pain**

【250】**Time and mode of onset， e.g. sudden， gradual.**

【251】**Character， e.g. dull， vague， cramping， sharp， burning.**

【252】**Severity.**

【253】**Constancy，e.g. continuous (peritonitis)； intermittent (pain of intestinal colic).**

【254】**Location： where did it start? Has it moved?**

【255】**Radiation， e.g. loin to groin in ureteric colic.**

【256】**Effect of respiration， movement， food， defecation， micturition and menstruation.**

【257】**Vomiting.**

【258】**Did vomiting precede the pain?**

【259】**Frequency.**

【260】**Character， e.g. bile， faeculent， blood， coffee grounds.**

【261】**Defecation**

【262】**Constipation： absolute constipation with colicky abdominal pain， distension and vomiting suggests intestinal obstruction.**

【263】**Diarrhoea： frequency， consistency of stools， blood， mucus， pus.**

【264】**Fever**

【265】**Any rigors.**

【266】**Past history**

【267】**Previous surgery，e.g. adhesions may cause intestinal obstruction.**

【268】**Recent trauma， e.g. delayed rupture of spleen.**

【269】**Menstrual history， e.g. ectopic pregnancy.**

【270】**EXAMINATION**

【271】**General**

【272】Is the patient lying comfortably? Is the patient lying still but in pain， e.g. peritonitis? Is the patient writhing in agony， e.g. ureteric or biliary colic? Is the patient flushed， suggesting pyrexia?

【273】_Pulse， temperature， respiration_

【274】Pulse and temperature are raised in inflammatory conditions.

【275】They may also be raised with impending infarction of bowel.

【276】An increased respiratory rate might suggest chest infection referring pain to the abdomen.

【277】_Cervical lymphadenopathy_

【278】**Associated with mesenteric adenitis.**

【279】**Chest**

【280】Referred pain from lobar pneumonia.

【281】**Abdomen**

【282】**Inspection. Does the abdomen move on respiration? Look for scars， distension， visible peristalsis (usually due to chronic obstruction in patient with very thin abdominal wall). Check the hernial orifices. Are there any obvious masses， e.g. visible， pulsatile mass to suggest aortic aneurysm?**

【283】**Palpation. The patient should be relaxed， lying flat， with arms by side. Be gentle and start as far from the painful site as possible. Check for guarding and rigidity. Check for masses， e.g. appendix mass， pulsatile expansile mass to suggest aortic aneurysm. Carefully examine the hernial orifices. Examine the testes to exclude torsion.**

【284】**Percussion， e.g. tympanitic note with distension with intestinal obstruction； dullness over bladder due to acute retention.**

【285】**Auscultation. Take your time (30-60s)； e.g. silent abdomen of peritonitis；high-pitched tinkling bowel sounds of intestinal obstruction.**

【286】**Rectal examination**

【287】**Always carry out a rectal examination.**

【288】**Vaginal examination**

【289】There may be discharge or tenderness associated with pelvic inflammatory disease. Examine the uterus and adnexa， e.g. pregnancy， fibroids， ectopic pregnancy.

【290】**GENERAL INVESTIGATIONS**

【291】**FBC， ESR**

【292】Hb↓ peptic ulcer disease， malignancy. WCC t infective/inflammatory disease， e.g. appendicitis， diverticulitis. ESR Crohn's disease， TB.

【77】**HOW TO USE THIS BOOK**

【78】**This book has been written in three sections： Clinical Presentations， Biochemical Presentations and Haematological Presentations.**

【79】In the Clinical Presentations section (Section A)， we have attempted to indicate the relative frequency of the conditions causing the various symptoms and signs by colour coding them in green， orange and red， according to whether they are considered common， occasional or rare， respectively.

【80】**A common cause of the symptom or sign**

【81】**Might occasionally give rise to the symptom or sign**

【82】**Will only rarely cause the symptom or sign**

【83】This has been no easy task (and indeed in the Biochemical Presentations and Haematological Presentations sections， we found it so difficult that we abandoned it) but we hope that it will indicate to readers whether they are dealing with a common， occasional or rare disorder. It is appreciated that some conditions may be common in the UK and rare in other parts of the world (and vice versa). Where this is the case， the appropriate colour coding is indicated in brackets， e.g. Campylobacter is a common cause of diarrhoea in the UK and therefore coded green but rare in tropical Africa and therefore coded red and in brackets. We have tried to indicate the importance of the condition， not only in causing a particular symptom or sign， but also in its overall incidence， e.g. diverticular disease is a common condition and is a common cause of pain in the left iliac fossa and is therefore coded green. It is only an occasional cause of large bowel obstruction and in this context， is coded orange.

【84】At the end of each chapter， the reader will find a box containing either what we consider to be important learning points， or indicating symptoms and signs suggestive of significant pathology that require urgent action.

【246】**HISTORY**

【247】零碎段删除-1:<u>**Age**</u>

【248】Certain conditions are more likely to occur in certain age groups， e.g. mesenteric adenitis in children， diverticular disease in the elderly.

【249】**Pain**

【250】**Time and mode of onset， e.g. sudden， gradual.**

【251】**Character， e.g. dull， vague， cramping， sharp， burning.**

【252】**Severity.**

【253】**Constancy，e.g. continuous (peritonitis)； intermittent (pain of intestinal colic).**

【254】**Location： where did it start? Has it moved?**

【255】**Radiation， e.g. loin to groin in ureteric colic.**

【256】**Effect of respiration， movement， food， defecation， micturition and menstruation.**

【257】**Vomiting.**

【258】**Did vomiting precede the pain?**

【259】**Frequency.**

【260】**Character， e.g. bile， faeculent， blood， coffee grounds.**

【261】**Defecation**

【262】**Constipation： absolute constipation with colicky abdominal pain， distension and vomiting suggests intestinal obstruction.**

【263】**Diarrhoea： frequency， consistency of stools， blood， mucus， pus.**

【264】**Fever**

【265】**Any rigors.**

【266】**Past history**

【267】**Previous surgery，e.g. adhesions may cause intestinal obstruction.**

【268】**Recent trauma， e.g. delayed rupture of spleen.**

【269】**Menstrual history， e.g. ectopic pregnancy.**

【270】**EXAMINATION**

【271】**General**

【272】Is the patient lying comfortably? Is the patient lying still but in pain， e.g. peritonitis? Is the patient writhing in agony， e.g. ureteric or biliary colic? Is the patient flushed， suggesting pyrexia?

【273】_Pulse， temperature， respiration_

【274】Pulse and temperature are raised in inflammatory conditions.

【275】They may also be raised with impending infarction of bowel.

【276】An increased respiratory rate might suggest chest infection referring pain to the abdomen.

【277】_Cervical lymphadenopathy_

【278】**Associated with mesenteric adenitis.**

【279】**Chest**

【280】Referred pain from lobar pneumonia.

【281】**Abdomen**

【282】**Inspection. Does the abdomen move on respiration? Look for scars， distension， visible peristalsis (usually due to chronic obstruction in patient with very thin abdominal wall). Check the hernial orifices. Are there any obvious masses， e.g. visible， pulsatile mass to suggest aortic aneurysm?**

【283】**Palpation. The patient should be relaxed， lying flat， with arms by side. Be gentle and start as far from the painful site as possible. Check for guarding and rigidity. Check for masses， e.g. appendix mass， pulsatile expansile mass to suggest aortic aneurysm. Carefully examine the hernial orifices. Examine the testes to exclude torsion.**

【284】**Percussion， e.g. tympanitic note with distension with intestinal obstruction； dullness over bladder due to acute retention.**

【285】**Auscultation. Take your time (30-60s)； e.g. silent abdomen of peritonitis；high-pitched tinkling bowel sounds of intestinal obstruction.**

【286】**Rectal examination**

【287】**Always carry out a rectal examination.**

【288】**Vaginal examination**

【289】There may be discharge or tenderness associated with pelvic inflammatory disease. Examine the uterus and adnexa， e.g. pregnancy， fibroids， ectopic pregnancy.

【2】**CLINICAL DECISION MAKING**

【3】**Case Study Analysis**

【4】· The complaint of fatigue is nonspecific and hard to analyze because ofthe multitude of conditions it accompanies.

【5】· Additionally， the symptoms must be distinguished but not forgotten in the investigation of the chief complaint.

【6】· After investigation of the patient's history the provider finds the patient is both a vege- _arian and on a proton pump inhibitor (PPI)._

【7】These two findings put the patient at risk for both iron deficient anemia and pernicious anemia.

【8】· The patient has no peripheral edema， jugular venous distention (JVD)， hepatomegaly， or fluid wave.

【9】·Diagnostic exams will differentiate the two and produce a clear diagnosis. However， until an electrocardiogram， brain natriuretic peptide (BNP)， and transthoracic echocar-diogram (TTE) are completed， treatment should be focused on correcting the anemia.

【10】**· Heart failure must be still be considered until ruled out with EKG， BNP， and TTE.**

【3】**Case Study Analysis**

【4】· The complaint of fatigue is nonspecific and hard to analyze because ofthe multitude of conditions it accompanies.

【6】· After investigation of the patient's history the provider finds the patient is both a vege- _arian and on a proton pump inhibitor (PPI)._

【7】These two findings put the patient at risk for both iron deficient anemia and pernicious anemia.

【8】· The patient has no peripheral edema， jugular venous distention (JVD)， hepatomegaly， or fluid wave.

【9】·Diagnostic exams will differentiate the two and produce a clear diagnosis. However， until an electrocardiogram， brain natriuretic peptide (BNP)， and transthoracic echocar-diogram (TTE) are completed， treatment should be focused on correcting the anemia.

【10】**· Heart failure must be still be considered until ruled out with EKG， BNP， and TTE.**

【12】**Rule Out Heart Failure**

【13】The patient appears undernourished. A complete dietary history needs to be completed to analyze the patient’s sources ofiron. Iron supplementation needs to be prescribed along with counseling on vitamin supple-ments，

【1】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**Alopecia areata can be extremely disfiguring. Whether or not stress plays a part in provoking it， it is certain that the alopecia is often itself a source of severe stress. This relationship is certainly perceived by sufferers. It is not proven that this stress perpetuates the condition， but the possibility should be borne in mind in the management of these patients. Psychological approaches do not significantly modify the course of the disease but do help patients cope with hair loss.**</u>

【2】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**Alopecia in males and females**</u>

【3】结尾批量删除-1:<u>In studies in Continental Europe， even though bald males were considered more intelligent than their non-bald colleagues， some balding males suffered a loss of self-esteem and some degree of psychological maladjustment that was improved when hair regrowth was initiated with a topical agent. Balding in females resulted in a gradual but in-depth change in social and private behaviour. They had more psychosocial problems， which they attributed to the hair loss， than men with androgenetic alopecia or women without visible dermatological conditions. During such psychosocial enquiries， the women with androgenetic alopecia were rated higher for self-sufficiency and social inadequacy， rigidity and general psychological maladjustment， but had lower scores for injuredness， self-evaluation and self-esteem than men. Globally， men are afraid of looking older， whereas women feel less feminine. If the importance of hair is as described， the fact that smoking might aggravate the problem should be taken as another opportunity to modify human behaviour and diminish the positive images associated with smoking， seeing it rather as a personal and social nuisance.</u>

【4】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**ARTEFACTS**</u>

【5】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**Artefacts are self-inflicted lesions， but the term as usually employed excludes such lesions produced accidentally through the abuse of mechanical or chemical cosmetic procedures. The most frequent form of deliberate artefact of the scalp consists of**</u>

结尾批量删除-1:<u>**Figure 8.4|删除2图换行|Trichotillomania associated with severe male pattern baldness.</u>

【7】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**plucking the hair， so-called trichotillomania . In children， the partially bald patches so produced are seldom of serious psychiatric significance， but the plucking systematically of almost all the head hair in an adult usually indicates a very serious personality disorder， as does extensive self-mutilation of the skin in any region of the body. This tonsure trichotillomania is very rare in men ， mostly occurring in women from 15 to 35 years of age.**</u>

【8】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**Deliberate physical or chemical production of other injuries of the scalp is very unusual， but it is possible that some cases are undiagnosed. Trichoteiromania due to excess rubbing of scalp has recently been identified as a new variant of hair mania. These subjectsare more open to talk about their habit than those affected by true trichotillomania. Trichoklepto-mania might describe pulling and taking away hair from another individual .**</u>

【9】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**THE RELIGIOUS SIGNIFICANCE OF HAIR**</u>

【10】结尾批量删除-1:<u>Hair has two perceived symbolic meanings in a religious context. Shaven or shorn hair， or even total scalp epilation by plucking， is a symbol of bodily-including sexualdedication to the gods， i.e. celibacy and chastity. Monks and nuns， both Buddhist and</u>

【11】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**Christian， have shaven heads， as do Hindu priests and widows. Hair sacrifice and offering to the gods was widespread in many ancient religions. The hair was offered for fertility， for victory， in fulfilment of a vow， and in place of human sacrifice. The practice continues today. The temple of Tirupati in southern India is a renowned pilgrimage site for such offerings， which， it is said， also contribute to the temple revenues. In contrast， matted， uncut hair is seen as withdrawal from worldly concerns and vanities in the Hindu sadhu . Sometimes long hair is a religious requirement， as in the Sikh religion and for the Rastafarians， although in both groups it has now also become a symbol of identity as well as a religious tenet.**</u>

【12】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**In patriarchal religious societies， married females cut their hair as a submission to male authority； wigs are used for appearances in public while natural hair is shown in privacy， once again illustrating the fears of the seductive power of female hair!**</u>

【13】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**HAIR CUTTING AS PUNISHMENT**</u>

【14】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**Many peoples have practised cutting off or shaving the hair as a punishment. The Ainu of Hokkaido， the northernmost island of**</u>

结尾批量删除-1:<u>**Figure 8.5|删除2图换行|Uncut and matted head and face hair-religious sign of withdrawal from worldly concerns and vanities.</u>

结尾批量删除-1:<u>**Japan， have a long-established reputation for hirsutism： they are in fact a proto-Caucasoid stock who are no more hirsute than many other Caucasoids， although very hairy|删除0换行|compared with their Japanese neighbours. Among the Ainu， great emphasis is placed on the possession of a very full beard and abundant head hair and the enforced cutting of hair is regarded as a severe punishment associated with loss of honour. Women’s hair is cut as punishment for adultery. The same punishment was used in Europe after the Second World War on women who had associated with soldiers of occupying armies.**</u>

【17】结尾批量删除-1:<u>The importance placed on short hair by the armed forces of many countries reinforces the popular association between short hair and authority and discipline. Conversely， Japanese troops imposed the wearing of long hair on Chinese males in order for them to look like females， which was considered injurious.</u>

【18】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**HAIRSTYLE**</u>

【19】结尾批量删除-1:<u>The importance of hair as a component of the body image has been mentioned， and vast amounts of money are expended on styling hair. The length， the colour and the style in which it is worn must conform to an accepted stereotype. Some knowledge of recent research on such stereotypes is helpful in increasing a dermatologist's understanding of some of his patients who appear to be endeavouring perversely to demand from their hair qualities with which nature failed to endow it.</u>

【20】结尾批量删除-1:<u>Long hair in males in the USA is said by some to be a reflection of group attitudes culturally defined rather than of personal feelings of sexual identity. The finding of some investigators on male students classified as ‘deviant'in hair length were not unexpected； the deviants with hair reaching below their shoulders assigned independence and less value to recognition and conformity than the non-deviant students. The stereotypes accepted among students have been found to vary from one university to another even during the same period， being influenced by the conservatism or liberalism of the community in which the university is situated. Long hair has been seen as a protest， but the increasing number of hairstylists for young men seems to indicate that many of them need an artificial aid to win or to retain a desired self-esteem.</u>

【21】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**In the 1980s short hair was again the norm， and long hair was often a badge of defiance， e.g. the Rastafarian style. Short hair can also be a symbol of defiance， as in the skinheads and punks. The 1920s passion for the “bob’ was seen as such by parents and authority figures. Differentiation of those ‘group-associated hairstyles’ may be difficult， as many balding males， any age， shave their hair in order to make hair loss less visible， following a trend launched by many sportsmen.**</u>

【22】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**HAIR COLOUR**</u>

【23】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**As with other stereotypes， those concerning hair colour apply to the communities studied and to the period of the study. Nevertheless， they throw considerable light on deeply rooted concepts and prejudices.**</u>

结尾批量删除-1:<u>**Yellow hair or a yellow wig was the trademark of a prostitute in ancient Rome. Blond hair is associated with both innocence， as in so many fairy tales， and， conversely， with sexual allure， as exemplified by Marilyn Monroe and other screen goddesses. Dark hair|删除0换行|has connotations of night and mystery and is essential for the ‘vamp’. Enquiries in Continental Europe revealed that red hair was associated with the idea of being less serious. Strangely， red hair has been associated with bad odours， indicating deeply rooted unconscious belief in some cultures.**</u>

【25】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**BEARDS**</u>

【26】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**Ancient Egyptian Pharaohs， male or female， associated power with wearing a fake beard. Numerous psychological studies carried out on the subject of beards show a generally positive correlation between the amount of hair on the subject’s face and high ratings for masculinity， maturity， good looks， dominance， self-confidence and other desirable traits. Similar findings have been reported from the University of Chicago. However， at the rural and more conserva-tive University of Wyoming， only 12.8% of females preferred men with a very full beard， whereas 40% preferred no facial hair and 42% preferred a moustache but no beard.**</u>

【27】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**MOUSTACHES**</u>

【28】结尾批量删除-1:<u>Few investigations have been made of the correlation of moustaches with personality traits or of observer reactions to them. In studies of British Army personnel in the years1950-1960， moustaches were divided into four types：</u>

All those with clipped moustaches failed to pass the selection board (but not of course on account of their moustaches). They were limited in imagination with little appreciation of the opinions of others and they tended to create rather than to decrease interpersonal tensions. Men with line moustaches passed the board at only half the normal rate； those that failed showed obsessive health consciousness. Men with bushy moustaches passed at the normal rate； those that failed tended to self-indulgence and self-display. Australian observations over 20 years ago suggested an association between moustaches and sexual pathology， but did not allow any firm conclusions to be drawn.**</u>

结尾批量删除-1:<u>**Hair and politics have not been studied thoroughly： this subject definitely should be a potential source of information on the perpetuation of hair icons. Think only of the scalp hairstyle of US and USSR presidents during the second half of the 20th century： a sharp contrast between youthful-looking USA and the balding USSR. Whatever the merit of the individuals， images of success and failure were reinforced at the end! Think of the more recent preparation for the 2003 war between the USA and Iraq. Everyone probably remembers the hands of an anonymous hairdresser bringing the last touch on the hair of the president of the USA. This scene was shown on almost all TV screens worldwide-in|删除0换行|our opinion during an exceedingly long period of time in view of the gravity of the situation-as the first military actions against Iraq were to be announced officially. On the other side， the Iraqi president conveyed the identification power of the moustaches on his troops. Indeed， as it appeared in magazines， 20 out of 20 military staff surrounding the then ruling Iraqi leader wore similar types of moustaches.</u>

【1】结尾批量删除-1:Alopecia areata can be extremely disfiguring. Whether or not stress plays a part in provoking it， it is certain that the alopecia is often itself a source of severe stress. This relationship is certainly perceived by sufferers. It is not proven that this stress perpetuates the condition， but the possibility should be borne in mind in the management of these patients. Psychological approaches do not significantly modify the course of the disease but do help patients cope with hair loss.

【2】结尾批量删除-1:Alopecia in males and females

【3】结尾批量删除-1:In studies in Continental Europe， even though bald males were considered more intelligent than their non-bald colleagues， some balding males suffered a loss of self-esteem and some degree of psychological maladjustment that was improved when hair regrowth was initiated with a topical agent. Balding in females resulted in a gradual but in-depth change in social and private behaviour. They had more psychosocial problems， which they attributed to the hair loss， than men with androgenetic alopecia or women without visible dermatological conditions. During such psychosocial enquiries， the women with androgenetic alopecia were rated higher for self-sufficiency and social inadequacy， rigidity and general psychological maladjustment， but had lower scores for injuredness， self-evaluation and self-esteem than men. Globally， men are afraid of looking older， whereas women feel less feminine. If the importance of hair is as described， the fact that smoking might aggravate the problem should be taken as another opportunity to modify human behaviour and diminish the positive images associated with smoking， seeing it rather as a personal and social nuisance.

【7】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**plucking the hair， so-called trichotillomania . In children， the partially bald patches so produced are seldom of serious psychiatric significance， but the plucking systematically of almost all the head hair in an adult usually indicates a very serious personality disorder， as does extensive self-mutilation of the skin in any region of the body. This tonsure trichotillomania is very rare in men ， mostly occurring in women from 15 to 35 years of age.**</u>

【8】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**Deliberate physical or chemical production of other injuries of the scalp is very unusual， but it is possible that some cases are undiagnosed. Trichoteiromania due to excess rubbing of scalp has recently been identified as a new variant of hair mania. These subjectsare more open to talk about their habit than those affected by true trichotillomania. Trichoklepto-mania might describe pulling and taking away hair from another individual .**</u>

【9】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**THE RELIGIOUS SIGNIFICANCE OF HAIR**</u>

【10】结尾批量删除-1:<u>Hair has two perceived symbolic meanings in a religious context. Shaven or shorn hair， or even total scalp epilation by plucking， is a symbol of bodily-including sexualdedication to the gods， i.e. celibacy and chastity. Monks and nuns， both Buddhist and</u>

【11】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**Christian， have shaven heads， as do Hindu priests and widows. Hair sacrifice and offering to the gods was widespread in many ancient religions. The hair was offered for fertility， for victory， in fulfilment of a vow， and in place of human sacrifice. The practice continues today. The temple of Tirupati in southern India is a renowned pilgrimage site for such offerings， which， it is said， also contribute to the temple revenues. In contrast， matted， uncut hair is seen as withdrawal from worldly concerns and vanities in the Hindu sadhu . Sometimes long hair is a religious requirement， as in the Sikh religion and for the Rastafarians， although in both groups it has now also become a symbol of identity as well as a religious tenet.**</u>

【12】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**In patriarchal religious societies， married females cut their hair as a submission to male authority； wigs are used for appearances in public while natural hair is shown in privacy， once again illustrating the fears of the seductive power of female hair!**</u>

结尾批量删除-1:<u>**Japan， have a long-established reputation for hirsutism： they are in fact a proto-Caucasoid stock who are no more hirsute than many other Caucasoids， although very hairy|删除0换行|compared with their Japanese neighbours. Among the Ainu， great emphasis is placed on the possession of a very full beard and abundant head hair and the enforced cutting of hair is regarded as a severe punishment associated with loss of honour. Women’s hair is cut as punishment for adultery. The same punishment was used in Europe after the Second World War on women who had associated with soldiers of occupying armies.**</u>

【17】结尾批量删除-1:<u>The importance placed on short hair by the armed forces of many countries reinforces the popular association between short hair and authority and discipline. Conversely， Japanese troops imposed the wearing of long hair on Chinese males in order for them to look like females， which was considered injurious.</u>

【18】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**HAIRSTYLE**</u>

【19】结尾批量删除-1:<u>The importance of hair as a component of the body image has been mentioned， and vast amounts of money are expended on styling hair. The length， the colour and the style in which it is worn must conform to an accepted stereotype. Some knowledge of recent research on such stereotypes is helpful in increasing a dermatologist's understanding of some of his patients who appear to be endeavouring perversely to demand from their hair qualities with which nature failed to endow it.</u>

【20】结尾批量删除-1:<u>Long hair in males in the USA is said by some to be a reflection of group attitudes culturally defined rather than of personal feelings of sexual identity. The finding of some investigators on male students classified as ‘deviant'in hair length were not unexpected； the deviants with hair reaching below their shoulders assigned independence and less value to recognition and conformity than the non-deviant students. The stereotypes accepted among students have been found to vary from one university to another even during the same period， being influenced by the conservatism or liberalism of the community in which the university is situated. Long hair has been seen as a protest， but the increasing number of hairstylists for young men seems to indicate that many of them need an artificial aid to win or to retain a desired self-esteem.</u>

【21】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**In the 1980s short hair was again the norm， and long hair was often a badge of defiance， e.g. the Rastafarian style. Short hair can also be a symbol of defiance， as in the skinheads and punks. The 1920s passion for the “bob’ was seen as such by parents and authority figures. Differentiation of those ‘group-associated hairstyles’ may be difficult， as many balding males， any age， shave their hair in order to make hair loss less visible， following a trend launched by many sportsmen.**</u>

【22】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**HAIR COLOUR**</u>

【23】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**As with other stereotypes， those concerning hair colour apply to the communities studied and to the period of the study. Nevertheless， they throw considerable light on deeply rooted concepts and prejudices.**</u>

结尾批量删除-1:<u>**Yellow hair or a yellow wig was the trademark of a prostitute in ancient Rome. Blond hair is associated with both innocence， as in so many fairy tales， and， conversely， with sexual allure， as exemplified by Marilyn Monroe and other screen goddesses. Dark hair|删除0换行|has connotations of night and mystery and is essential for the ‘vamp’. Enquiries in Continental Europe revealed that red hair was associated with the idea of being less serious. Strangely， red hair has been associated with bad odours， indicating deeply rooted unconscious belief in some cultures.**</u>

【25】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**BEARDS**</u>

【26】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**Ancient Egyptian Pharaohs， male or female， associated power with wearing a fake beard. Numerous psychological studies carried out on the subject of beards show a generally positive correlation between the amount of hair on the subject’s face and high ratings for masculinity， maturity， good looks， dominance， self-confidence and other desirable traits. Similar findings have been reported from the University of Chicago. However， at the rural and more conserva-tive University of Wyoming， only 12.8% of females preferred men with a very full beard， whereas 40% preferred no facial hair and 42% preferred a moustache but no beard.**</u>

All those with clipped moustaches failed to pass the selection board (but not of course on account of their moustaches). They were limited in imagination with little appreciation of the opinions of others and they tended to create rather than to decrease interpersonal tensions. Men with line moustaches passed the board at only half the normal rate； those that failed showed obsessive health consciousness. Men with bushy moustaches passed at the normal rate； those that failed tended to self-indulgence and self-display. Australian observations over 20 years ago suggested an association between moustaches and sexual pathology， but did not allow any firm conclusions to be drawn.**</u>

Whatever the merit of the individuals， images of success and failure were reinforced at the end! Think of the more recent preparation for the 2003 war between the USA and Iraq. <mark>【1】结尾批量删除-1:Alopecia areata can be extremely disfiguring. Whether or not stress plays a part in provoking it， it is certain that the alopecia is often itself a source of severe stress. This relationship is certainly perceived by sufferers. It is not proven that this stress perpetuates the condition， but the possibility should be borne in mind in the management of these patients. Psychological approaches do not significantly modify the course of the disease but do help patients cope with hair loss.

【2】结尾批量删除-1:Alopecia in males and females

【3】结尾批量删除-1:In studies in Continental Europe， even though bald males were considered more intelligent than their non-bald colleagues， some balding males suffered a loss of self-esteem and some degree of psychological maladjustment that was improved when hair regrowth was initiated with a topical agent. Balding in females resulted in a gradual but in-depth change in social and private behaviour. They had more psychosocial problems， which they attributed to the hair loss， than men with androgenetic alopecia or women without visible dermatological conditions. During such psychosocial enquiries， the women with androgenetic alopecia were rated higher for self-sufficiency and social inadequacy， rigidity and general psychological maladjustment， but had lower scores for injuredness， self-evaluation and self-esteem than men. Globally， men are afraid of looking older， whereas women feel less feminine. If the importance of hair is as described， the fact that smoking might aggravate the problem should be taken as another opportunity to modify human behaviour and diminish the positive images associated with smoking， seeing it rather as a personal and social nuisance.

【9】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**THE RELIGIOUS SIGNIFICANCE OF HAIR**</u>

【10】结尾批量删除-1:<u>Hair has two perceived symbolic meanings in a religious context. Shaven or shorn hair， or even total scalp epilation by plucking， is a symbol of bodily-including sexualdedication to the gods， i.e. celibacy and chastity. Monks and nuns， both Buddhist and</u>

【11】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**Christian， have shaven heads， as do Hindu priests and widows. Hair sacrifice and offering to the gods was widespread in many ancient religions. The hair was offered for fertility， for victory， in fulfilment of a vow， and in place of human sacrifice. The practice continues today. The temple of Tirupati in southern India is a renowned pilgrimage site for such offerings， which， it is said， also contribute to the temple revenues. In contrast， matted， uncut hair is seen as withdrawal from worldly concerns and vanities in the Hindu sadhu . Sometimes long hair is a religious requirement， as in the Sikh religion and for the Rastafarians， although in both groups it has now also become a symbol of identity as well as a religious tenet.**</u>

【12】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**In patriarchal religious societies， married females cut their hair as a submission to male authority； wigs are used for appearances in public while natural hair is shown in privacy， once again illustrating the fears of the seductive power of female hair!**</u>

【13】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**HAIR CUTTING AS PUNISHMENT**</u>

【14】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**Many peoples have practised cutting off or shaving the hair as a punishment. The Ainu of Hokkaido， the northernmost island of**</u>

结尾批量删除-1:<u>**Japan， have a long-established reputation for hirsutism： they are in fact a proto-Caucasoid stock who are no more hirsute than many other Caucasoids， although very hairy|删除0换行|compared with their Japanese neighbours. Among the Ainu， great emphasis is placed on the possession of a very full beard and abundant head hair and the enforced cutting of hair is regarded as a severe punishment associated with loss of honour. Women’s hair is cut as punishment for adultery. The same punishment was used in Europe after the Second World War on women who had associated with soldiers of occupying armies.**</u>

【17】结尾批量删除-1:<u>The importance placed on short hair by the armed forces of many countries reinforces the popular association between short hair and authority and discipline. Conversely， Japanese troops imposed the wearing of long hair on Chinese males in order for them to look like females， which was considered injurious.</u>

【18】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**HAIRSTYLE**</u>

【19】结尾批量删除-1:<u>The importance of hair as a component of the body image has been mentioned， and vast amounts of money are expended on styling hair. The length， the colour and the style in which it is worn must conform to an accepted stereotype. Some knowledge of recent research on such stereotypes is helpful in increasing a dermatologist's understanding of some of his patients who appear to be endeavouring perversely to demand from their hair qualities with which nature failed to endow it.</u>

【20】结尾批量删除-1:<u>Long hair in males in the USA is said by some to be a reflection of group attitudes culturally defined rather than of personal feelings of sexual identity. The finding of some investigators on male students classified as ‘deviant'in hair length were not unexpected； the deviants with hair reaching below their shoulders assigned independence and less value to recognition and conformity than the non-deviant students. The stereotypes accepted among students have been found to vary from one university to another even during the same period， being influenced by the conservatism or liberalism of the community in which the university is situated. Long hair has been seen as a protest， but the increasing number of hairstylists for young men seems to indicate that many of them need an artificial aid to win or to retain a desired self-esteem.</u>

【21】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**In the 1980s short hair was again the norm， and long hair was often a badge of defiance， e.g. the Rastafarian style. Short hair can also be a symbol of defiance， as in the skinheads and punks. The 1920s passion for the “bob’ was seen as such by parents and authority figures. Differentiation of those ‘group-associated hairstyles’ may be difficult， as many balding males， any age， shave their hair in order to make hair loss less visible， following a trend launched by many sportsmen.**</u>

【22】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**HAIR COLOUR**</u>

【23】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**As with other stereotypes， those concerning hair colour apply to the communities studied and to the period of the study. Nevertheless， they throw considerable light on deeply rooted concepts and prejudices.**</u>

结尾批量删除-1:<u>**Yellow hair or a yellow wig was the trademark of a prostitute in ancient Rome. Blond hair is associated with both innocence， as in so many fairy tales， and， conversely， with sexual allure， as exemplified by Marilyn Monroe and other screen goddesses. Dark hair|删除0换行|has connotations of night and mystery and is essential for the ‘vamp’. Enquiries in Continental Europe revealed that red hair was associated with the idea of being less serious. Strangely， red hair has been associated with bad odours， indicating deeply rooted unconscious belief in some cultures.**</u>

【25】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**BEARDS**</u>

【26】结尾批量删除-1:<u>**Ancient Egyptian Pharaohs， male or female， associated power with wearing a fake beard. Numerous psychological studies carried out on the subject of beards show a generally positive correlation between the amount of hair on the subject’s face and high ratings for masculinity， maturity， good looks， dominance， self-confidence and other desirable traits. Similar findings have been reported from the University of Chicago. However， at the rural and more conserva-tive University of Wyoming， only 12.8% of females preferred men with a very full beard， whereas 40% preferred no facial hair and 42% preferred a moustache but no beard.**</u>

All those with clipped moustaches failed to pass the selection board (but not of course on account of their moustaches). They were limited in imagination with little appreciation of the opinions of others and they tended to create rather than to decrease interpersonal tensions. Men with line moustaches passed the board at only half the normal rate； those that failed showed obsessive health consciousness. Men with bushy moustaches passed at the normal rate； those that failed tended to self-indulgence and self-display. Australian observations over 20 years ago suggested an association between moustaches and sexual pathology， but did not allow any firm conclusions to be drawn.**</u>

结尾批量删除-1:<u>**Hair and politics have not been studied thoroughly： this subject definitely should be a potential source of information on the perpetuation of hair icons. Think only of the scalp hairstyle of US and USSR presidents during the second half of the 20th century： a sharp contrast between youthful-looking USA and the balding USSR. Whatever the merit of the individuals， images of success and failure were reinforced at the end! Think of the more recent preparation for the 2003 war between the USA and Iraq. Everyone probably remembers the hands of an anonymous hairdresser bringing the last touch on the hair of the president of the USA. This scene was shown on almost all TV screens worldwide-in|删除0换行|our opinion during an exceedingly long period of time in view of the gravity of the situation-as the first military actions against Iraq were to be announced officially. 【1】COccurs predominantly in the intraoral minor salivary glands， especially at the junction of the hard and soft palates

【2】May occur in the parotid gland

【3】VWide age range； peaks in fifth and sixth decades FFemale predominance (2：1) FFrequently presents as a firm， nontender swelling； can erode underlying bone

【4】Gross Pathology

【5】 Polypoid tumor usually with intact mucosal covering； rarely ulcerated

【6】Circumscribed， unencapsulated， firm mass with tan， homogeneous cut surface

【7】Typically ranges from 1 to 5 cm

【8】Histopathology

【9】VWell circumscribed， but lacks a capsule and shows peripheral infiltration into surrounding tissue (often infiltrates in single-file pattern)

【10】Patterns include solid， tubular， trabecular， and ductular 删除2:<u>(cribriform， cystic， and papillary-cystic may be focally seen)</u>； mixed patterns account for the polymorphous appearance

【11】May show a single-file pattern， narrow ductlike structures； may display a characteristic concentric whirling pattern at the periphery

【12】Composed of uniform， cytologically bland， cuboidal to columnar to spindle-shaped cells with round to ovoid nuclei and inconspicuous to obvious nucleoli； scant， eosinophilic to clear cytoplasm and indistinct cell borders

【13】Nuclear clearing that may mimic papillary thyroid carcinoma

【14】Variable collagenous or hyaline stroma； tyrosine crystals rarely seen

【15】Mitotic figures and necrosis are rare

【16】Infiltrative growth pattern； may invade adjacent bone

【17】Propensity for perineural invasion，vascular invasion is less frequent

【18】Wide surgical resection is treatment of choice； resection of adjacent bone necessary if bony infiltration is present

【19】Special Stains and Immunohistochemistry

【20】S-100 often positive

【24】Adenoid cystic carcinoma

【25】Occurs mostly in parotid， whereas PLGA occurs mostly in minor salivary glands

【26】**Characteristic cribriform architecture with nuclei that are hyperchromatic and angulated**

【27】Monomorphic adenoma

【28】**Well circumscribed without invasion into surrounding tissue**

【29】Monomorphous architectural pattern

【30】**No perineural invasion**

【31】**Pearls**

【32】1Most occur in minor salivary glands

【33】Recognition aided by combination of architectural features and bland cytology

【34】Mixed growth patterns lead to polymorphous appearance

【35】Although termed low grade， perineural invasion is common and may lead to local recurrences

【73】**Grade 2 (intermediate)： focal cystic areas with intervening cellular proliferation and invasive features**

【2】**HEPATOSPLENIC T-CELL LYMPHOMA**

【3】HSTL is a systemic disease preferentially affecting young males (15-30 years of age) derived from functionally immature innate effector cells， most often of y6 T-cell ori-gin， characterized by pancytopenia and prominent hepato-splenomegaly without adenopathy 通用删除6(英):<u>\[8，9，11，13，23-29\]</u>. It is an aggressive tumor involving the liver， spleen， and BM with characteristic intrasinusoidal distribution of tumor cells. HSTL may occur in immunocompromised patients and/or as a posttransplant lymphoproliferative disorder 通用删除6(英):<u>\[30-32\]</u>. Isochromosome 7q represents the primary nonrandom cyto-genetic abnormality and plays a role in its pathogenesis. The prognosis is poor with a median survival time of 16 months\[9，13，271.

【4】**MORPHOLOGY**

【5】**Liver**

【6】**The morphologic examination reveals distended hepatic sinusoids with monomorphic medium-sized lymphoid cells with a scanty cy toplasm and irregular nuclei . In contrast to other T-cell lymphoproliferations， the portal triads are usually not involved.**

【7】Spleen See Chapter 47.

【8】**Bone Marrow**

【9】The BM is involved in the majority of cases at diagno-sis and often leads to anemia and/or thrombocytopenia. Peripheral blood involvement is often present (50%-80%of cases) and is best diagnosed by flow cytometry 通用删除6(英):<u>\[9\]</u>. The BM is hypercellular and shows a characteristic intrasinu-soidal involvement . Minimal involvement or early phase of the disease may be difficult to recognize in routine H&E sections. Immunohistochemical stain-ing for CD3 and/or CD56 is very helpful in confirming BM disease. Advanced cases show a prominent intersti-tial to a diffuse pattern of involvement  with

【11】**IMMUNOPHENOTYPE**

【12】The tumor cells are positive for CD3， CD45， and TCR y/8 通用删除6(英):<u>\[9，11，23，25，27，33，34\]</u>. Rare cases of TCRoB+ HSTL have been reported 通用删除6(英):<u>\[35-38\]</u>. Majority of cases are dual CD4/CD8- and are negative for CD5 (rare cases display dim expression of CD5). Most cases are positive for CD2， CD7， and T-cell-restricted intracellular antigen (TIA)-1， and are negative for both CD4 and CD8 (only rare tumors may be CD8+). NK-cell-associated antigens are variably expressed： CD16 is positive in approximately one-fourth of cases， CD56 is positive in majority of cases， and CD57 is negative 通用删除6(英):<u>\[33，34，39\]</u>. Granzyme B and perforin are negative. Figures 41.10 and 41.11 show immunophenotypic findings in HSTL.

【13】**CYTOGENETICS/FISH AND MOlECULAR FEATURES**

【14】HSTL has been associated cytogenetically with the iso-chromosome 7q \[i(7)(q10)\] 通用删除6(英):<u>\[26，38，40，41\]</u>. An increased number of 7q signals can be found in cases with cytologic features of progression， indicating a tendency of hepato-splenic lymphoma to multiply the i(7)(q10) chromosome during evolution 通用删除6(英):<u>\[40\]</u>. Tamaska et al. 通用删除6(英):<u>\[42\]</u> described hepa-tosplenic yo T-cell lymphoma with ring chromosome 7， as an equivalent of i(7q) aberration. Trisomy 8 often accom-panies i(7q) 通用删除6(英):<u>\[26，32，40，42\]</u>. Figure 41.12 shows complex karyotypic changes， which include typical abnormality of chromosome 7.

【22】**PERIPHERAL T-CELL LYMPHOMAS**

【23】Peripheral T-cell lymphoproliferative disorders involving the liver (except for HSTL described above) include PTCL， unspecified (PTCL-U)， adult T-cellleukemia/lymphoma(ATLL)， angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma (AITL)， ALCL， and extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma， nasal type(ENKTL). Liver may also be infiltrated by T-cell prolympho-cytic leukemia (T-PLL) and T-LGL leukemia.

【24】**PERIPHERAL T-CElL LYMPHOMA**

【25】PTCL is diagnosed when clinical， laboratory， morphologic， and immunophenotypic features are not specific for any defined T-cell lymphoma category. Morphology and immunopheno-type are variable and are described in detail in Chapter 20. Figure 41.13 shows an example of PTCL involving the liver.

【26】**ADUlT T-CElL LEUKEMIA/LYMPHOMA**

【27】ATLL involves the blood and BM， and often the lymph nodes， liver， skin， GI tract， and head and neck area. Tumor cells are positive for CD4， CD5， and CD25 and in a majority of cases also for CD2 and CD3 .

【28】**ANAPLASTIC LARGE CEll LYMPHOMA**

【29】**ALCL often involves the extranodal sites. In both ALK+and ALK- cases， large tumor cells show strong expression of CD30 and most often aberrant expression of pan-T-cell antigens. Some cases may display “null cell"-type phenotype with negative expression of all pan-T-cell markers 删除2:<u>(CD2， CD3， CD5， and CD7； see Chapter 22 for details)</u>.**

【113】页码间删除-1:<u>**INTRODUCTION**</u>

【114】Primary lymphomas of the lung are rare and majority of them are represented by marginal zone lymphoma \[MZL； mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT type)\]， followed by diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL)， and sporadic cases of Hodgkin lymphoma (HL)， mantle cell lymphoma(MCL)， follicular lymphoma (FL)， B-cell chronic lympho-cytic leukemia (B-CLL)， anaplastic large cell lymphoma(ALCL)， and peripheral T-cell lymphoma (PTCL)， not otherwise specified 通用删除6(英):<u>\[1-6\]</u>.

【115】页码间删除-1:<u>**MZL (MALT TYPE)**</u>

【116】Pulmonary MZL (MALT lymphoma) may be associated with Sjogren's syndrome， rheumatoid arthritis， and other immu-nologic abnormalities. Low levels of monoclonal serum pro-teins are common.

【117】页码间删除-1:<u>**Morphology**</u>

MALT lymphoma of the lung shows a multifocal pattern of growth ， starting as a perilymphan-gitic infiltrate with eventual formation of infiltrative and|删除0换行|destructive masseswithin pulmonary parenchyma often extending into visceral pleura 通用删除6(英):<u>\[1，4，5，7-11\]</u>. Histologic fea-tures are similar to those observed in other locations. The lymphoid infiltrate shows predominance of small- to occa-sionally medium-sized lymphocytes and scattered larger cells with centroblastic morphology. The lymphoid cells often dis-play a typical monocytoid appearance. Plasma cells are pres-ent at various proportions and are often monotypic. Reactive germinal centers are usually present and show features of colonization by neoplastic lymphocytes. Lymphoepithelial lesions are common and neoplastic B cells may protrude into the lumen of the bronchi. 【3】HSTL is a systemic disease preferentially affecting young males (15-30 years of age) derived from functionally immature innate effector cells， most often of y6 T-cell ori-gin， characterized by pancytopenia and prominent hepato-splenomegaly without adenopathy 通用删除6(英):<u>\[8，9，11，13，23-29\]</u>. It is an aggressive tumor involving the liver， spleen， and BM with characteristic intrasinusoidal distribution of tumor cells. HSTL may occur in immunocompromised patients and/or as a posttransplant lymphoproliferative disorder 通用删除6(英):<u>\[30-32\]</u>. Isochromosome 7q represents the primary nonrandom cyto-genetic abnormality and plays a role in its pathogenesis. The prognosis is poor with a median survival time of 16 months\[9，13，271.

【5】**Liver**

【6】**The morphologic examination reveals distended hepatic sinusoids with monomorphic medium-sized lymphoid cells with a scanty cy toplasm and irregular nuclei . In contrast to other T-cell lymphoproliferations， the portal triads are usually not involved.**

Peripheral blood involvement is often present (50%-80%of cases) and is best diagnosed by flow cytometry 通用删除6(英):<u>\[9\]</u>. The BM is hypercellular and shows a characteristic intrasinu-soidal involvement . Minimal involvement or early phase of the disease may be difficult to recognize in routine H&E sections. 【113】页码间删除-1:<u>**INTRODUCTION**</u>

【114】Primary lymphomas of the lung are rare and majority of them are represented by marginal zone lymphoma \[MZL； mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT type)\]， followed by diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL)， and sporadic cases of Hodgkin lymphoma (HL)， mantle cell lymphoma(MCL)， follicular lymphoma (FL)， B-cell chronic lympho-cytic leukemia (B-CLL)， anaplastic large cell lymphoma(ALCL)， and peripheral T-cell lymphoma (PTCL)， not otherwise specified 通用删除6(英):<u>\[1-6\]</u>.

【115】页码间删除-1:<u>**MZL (MALT TYPE)**</u>

【116】Pulmonary MZL (MALT lymphoma) may be associated with Sjogren's syndrome， rheumatoid arthritis， and other immu-nologic abnormalities. Low levels of monoclonal serum pro-teins are common.

【117】页码间删除-1:<u>**Morphology**</u>

MALT lymphoma of the lung shows a multifocal pattern of growth ， starting as a perilymphan-gitic infiltrate with eventual formation of infiltrative and|删除0换行|destructive masseswithin pulmonary parenchyma often extending into visceral pleura 通用删除6(英):<u>\[1，4，5，7-11\]</u>. Histologic fea-tures are similar to those observed in other locations. The lymphoid infiltrate shows predominance of small- to occa-sionally medium-sized lymphocytes and scattered larger cells with centroblastic morphology. The lymphoid cells often dis-play a typical monocytoid appearance. Plasma cells are pres-ent at various proportions and are often monotypic. Reactive germinal centers are usually present and show features of colonization by neoplastic lymphocytes. Lymphoepithelial lesions are common and neoplastic B cells may protrude into the lumen of the bronchi. MALT lymphoma may be accompanied by pleural effusion and involvement of the peri-bronchial or mediastinal lymph nodes. Pulmonary MALT lymphomas may be associated with stromal amyloid deposi-tion 通用删除6(英):<u>\[12，13\]</u>.

【2】**HEPATOSPLENIC T-CELL LYMPHOMA<mark>
【3】</mark>【3】HSTL is a systemic disease preferentially affecting young males (15-30 years of age) derived from functionally immature innate effector cells， most often of y6 T-cell ori-gin， characterized by pancytopenia and prominent hepato-splenomegaly without adenopathy 通用删除6(英):<u>\[8，9，11，13，23-29\]</u>. It is an aggressive tumor involving the liver， spleen， and BM with characteristic intrasinusoidal distribution of tumor cells. HSTL may occur in immunocompromised patients and/or as a posttransplant lymphoproliferative disorder 通用删除6(英):<u>\[30-32\]</u>. Isochromosome 7q represents the primary nonrandom cyto-genetic abnormality and plays a role in its pathogenesis. The prognosis is poor with a median survival time of 16 months\[9，13，271.

【4】**MORPHOLOGY**

【5】**Liver**

【6】**The morphologic examination reveals distended hepatic sinusoids with monomorphic medium-sized lymphoid cells with a scanty cy toplasm and irregular nuclei . In contrast to other T-cell lymphoproliferations， the portal triads are usually not involved.**

【7】Spleen See Chapter 47.

【8】**Bone Marrow**

【9】The BM is involved in the majority of cases at diagno-sis and often leads to anemia and/or thrombocytopenia. Peripheral blood involvement is often present (50%-80%of cases) and is best diagnosed by flow cytometry 通用删除6(英):<u>\[9\]</u>. The BM is hypercellular and shows a characteristic intrasinu-soidal involvement . Minimal involvement or early phase of the disease may be difficult to recognize in routine H&E sections. Immunohistochemical stain-ing for CD3 and/or CD56 is very helpful in confirming BM disease. Advanced cases show a prominent intersti-tial to a diffuse pattern of involvement  with

通用删除16(英):<u>**FIGURE 41.7 Liver—HSTL. Atypical， mostly intrasinusoidal infiltrate of medium-sized cells.**</u>|删除换行|shift toward larger tumor cells， which may display blastic morphology通用删除6(英):<u>\[13\]</u>.**

【11】**IMMUNOPHENOTYPE**

【12】The tumor cells are positive for CD3， CD45， and TCR y/8 通用删除6(英):<u>\[9，11，23，25，27，33，34\]</u>. Rare cases of TCRoB+ HSTL have been reported 通用删除6(英):<u>\[35-38\]</u>. Majority of cases are dual CD4/CD8- and are negative for CD5 (rare cases display dim expression of CD5). Most cases are positive for CD2， CD7， and T-cell-restricted intracellular antigen (TIA)-1， and are negative for both CD4 and CD8 (only rare tumors may be CD8+). NK-cell-associated antigens are variably expressed： CD16 is positive in approximately one-fourth of cases， CD56 is positive in majority of cases， and CD57 is negative 通用删除6(英):<u>\[33，34，39\]</u>. Granzyme B and perforin are negative. Figures 41.10 and 41.11 show immunophenotypic findings in HSTL.

【13】**CYTOGENETICS/FISH AND MOlECULAR FEATURES**

【14】HSTL has been associated cytogenetically with the iso-chromosome 7q \[i(7)(q10)\] 通用删除6(英):<u>\[26，38，40，41\]</u>. An increased number of 7q signals can be found in cases with cytologic features of progression， indicating a tendency of hepato-splenic lymphoma to multiply the i(7)(q10) chromosome during evolution 通用删除6(英):<u>\[40\]</u>. Tamaska et al. 通用删除6(英):<u>\[42\]</u> described hepa-tosplenic yo T-cell lymphoma with ring chromosome 7， as an equivalent of i(7q) aberration. Trisomy 8 often accom-panies i(7q) 通用删除6(英):<u>\[26，32，40，42\]</u>. Figure 41.12 shows complex karyotypic changes， which include typical abnormality of chromosome 7.

【16】The differential diagnosis of HSTL includes B- and T-cell lymphoproliferative disorders and reactive lymphoid infil-trates. Intrasinusoidal involvement of the BM is not specific for HSTL and is displayed by other types of lymphoma as well \[ALCL， splenic lymphoma with villous lymphocytes，

【22】**PERIPHERAL T-CELL LYMPHOMAS**

【23】Peripheral T-cell lymphoproliferative disorders involving the liver (except for HSTL described above) include PTCL， unspecified (PTCL-U)， adult T-cellleukemia/lymphoma(ATLL)， angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma (AITL)， ALCL， and extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma， nasal type(ENKTL). Liver may also be infiltrated by T-cell prolympho-cytic leukemia (T-PLL) and T-LGL leukemia.

【24】**PERIPHERAL T-CElL LYMPHOMA**

【25】PTCL is diagnosed when clinical， laboratory， morphologic， and immunophenotypic features are not specific for any defined T-cell lymphoma category. Morphology and immunopheno-type are variable and are described in detail in Chapter 20. Figure 41.13 shows an example of PTCL involving the liver.

【26】**ADUlT T-CElL LEUKEMIA/LYMPHOMA**

【27】ATLL involves the blood and BM， and often the lymph nodes， liver， skin， GI tract， and head and neck area. Tumor cells are positive for CD4， CD5， and CD25 and in a majority of cases also for CD2 and CD3 .

【28】**ANAPLASTIC LARGE CEll LYMPHOMA**

【29】**ALCL often involves the extranodal sites. In both ALK+and ALK- cases， large tumor cells show strong expression of CD30 and most often aberrant expression of pan-T-cell antigens. Some cases may display “null cell"-type phenotype with negative expression of all pan-T-cell markers 删除2:<u>(CD2， CD3， CD5， and CD7； see Chapter 22 for details)</u>.**

【113】页码间删除-1:<u>**INTRODUCTION**</u>

【114】Primary lymphomas of the lung are rare and majority of them are represented by marginal zone lymphoma \[MZL； mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT type)\]， followed by diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL)， and sporadic cases of Hodgkin lymphoma (HL)， mantle cell lymphoma(MCL)， follicular lymphoma (FL)， B-cell chronic lympho-cytic leukemia (B-CLL)， anaplastic large cell lymphoma(ALCL)， and peripheral T-cell lymphoma (PTCL)， not otherwise specified 通用删除6(英):<u>\[1-6\]</u>.

【115】页码间删除-1:<u>**MZL (MALT TYPE)**</u>

【116】Pulmonary MZL (MALT lymphoma) may be associated with Sjogren's syndrome， rheumatoid arthritis， and other immu-nologic abnormalities. Low levels of monoclonal serum pro-teins are common.

【117】页码间删除-1:<u>**Morphology**</u>

MALT lymphoma of the lung shows a multifocal pattern of growth ， starting as a perilymphan-gitic infiltrate with eventual formation of infiltrative and|删除0换行|destructive masseswithin pulmonary parenchyma often extending into visceral pleura 通用删除6(英):<u>\[1，4，5，7-11\]</u>. Histologic fea-tures are similar to those observed in other locations. The lymphoid infiltrate shows predominance of small- to occa-sionally medium-sized lymphocytes and scattered larger cells with centroblastic morphology. The lymphoid cells often dis-play a typical monocytoid appearance. Plasma cells are pres-ent at various proportions and are often monotypic. Reactive germinal centers are usually present and show features of colonization by neoplastic lymphocytes. Lymphoepithelial lesions are common and neoplastic B cells may protrude into the lumen of the bronchi. MALT lymphoma may be accompanied by pleural effusion and involvement of the peri-bronchial or mediastinal lymph nodes. Pulmonary MALT lymphomas may be associated with stromal amyloid deposi-tion 通用删除6(英):<u>\[12，13\]</u>.

【2】**HEPATOSPLENIC T-CELL LYMPHOMA<mark>
【3】</mark>【3】HSTL is a systemic disease preferentially affecting young males (15-30 years of age) derived from functionally immature innate effector cells， most often of y6 T-cell ori-gin， characterized by pancytopenia and prominent hepato-splenomegaly without adenopathy 通用删除6(英):<u>\[8，9，11，13，23-29\]</u>. It is an aggressive tumor involving the liver， spleen， and BM with characteristic intrasinusoidal distribution of tumor cells. HSTL may occur in immunocompromised patients and/or as a posttransplant lymphoproliferative disorder 通用删除6(英):<u>\[30-32\]</u>. Isochromosome 7q represents the primary nonrandom cyto-genetic abnormality and plays a role in its pathogenesis. The prognosis is poor with a median survival time of 16 months\[9，13，271.

【4】**MORPHOLOGY**

【5】**Liver**

【6】**The morphologic examination reveals distended hepatic sinusoids with monomorphic medium-sized lymphoid cells with a scanty cy toplasm and irregular nuclei . In contrast to other T-cell lymphoproliferations， the portal triads are usually not involved.**

<mark>【7】Spleen See Chapter 47.</mark>

【8】**Bone Marrow**

【9】The BM is involved in the majority of cases at diagno-sis and often leads to anemia and/or thrombocytopenia. Peripheral blood involvement is often present (50%-80%of cases) and is best diagnosed by flow cytometry 通用删除6(英):<u>\[9\]</u>. The BM is hypercellular and shows a characteristic intrasinu-soidal involvement . Minimal involvement or early phase of the disease may be difficult to recognize in routine H&E sections. Immunohistochemical stain-ing for CD3 and/or CD56 is very helpful in confirming BM disease. Advanced cases show a prominent intersti-tial to a diffuse pattern of involvement  with

【11】**IMMUNOPHENOTYPE**

【12】The tumor cells are positive for CD3， CD45， and TCR y/8 通用删除6(英):<u>\[9，11，23，25，27，33，34\]</u>. Rare cases of TCRoB+ HSTL have been reported 通用删除6(英):<u>\[35-38\]</u>. Majority of cases are dual CD4/CD8- and are negative for CD5 (rare cases display dim expression of CD5). Most cases are positive for CD2， CD7， and T-cell-restricted intracellular antigen (TIA)-1， and are negative for both CD4 and CD8 (only rare tumors may be CD8+). NK-cell-associated antigens are variably expressed： CD16 is positive in approximately one-fourth of cases， CD56 is positive in majority of cases， and CD57 is negative 通用删除6(英):<u>\[33，34，39\]</u>. Granzyme B and perforin are negative. Figures 41.10 and 41.11 show immunophenotypic findings in HSTL.

【13】**CYTOGENETICS/FISH AND MOlECULAR FEATURES**

【14】HSTL has been associated cytogenetically with the iso-chromosome 7q \[i(7)(q10)\] 通用删除6(英):<u>\[26，38，40，41\]</u>. An increased number of 7q signals can be found in cases with cytologic features of progression， indicating a tendency of hepato-splenic lymphoma to multiply the i(7)(q10) chromosome during evolution 通用删除6(英):<u>\[40\]</u>. Tamaska et al. 通用删除6(英):<u>\[42\]</u> described hepa-tosplenic yo T-cell lymphoma with ring chromosome 7， as an equivalent of i(7q) aberration. Trisomy 8 often accom-panies i(7q) 通用删除6(英):<u>\[26，32，40，42\]</u>. Figure 41.12 shows complex karyotypic changes， which include typical abnormality of chromosome 7.

【16】The differential diagnosis of HSTL includes B- and T-cell lymphoproliferative disorders and reactive lymphoid infil-trates. Intrasinusoidal involvement of the BM is not specific for HSTL and is displayed by other types of lymphoma as well \[ALCL， splenic lymphoma with villous lymphocytes，
