【22】**PERIPHERAL T-CELL LYMPHOMAS**

【23】Peripheral T-cell lymphoproliferative disorders involving the liver (except for HSTL described above) include PTCL， unspecified (PTCL-U)， adult T-cellleukemia/lymphoma(ATLL)， angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma (AITL)， ALCL， and extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma， nasal type(ENKTL). Liver may also be infiltrated by T-cell prolympho-cytic leukemia (T-PLL) and T-LGL leukemia.

【24】**PERIPHERAL T-CElL LYMPHOMA**

【25】PTCL is diagnosed when clinical， laboratory， morphologic， and immunophenotypic features are not specific for any defined T-cell lymphoma category. Morphology and immunopheno-type are variable and are described in detail in Chapter 20. Figure 41.13 shows an example of PTCL involving the liver.

【26】**ADUlT T-CElL LEUKEMIA/LYMPHOMA**

【27】ATLL involves the blood and BM， and often the lymph nodes， liver， skin， GI tract， and head and neck area. Tumor cells are positive for CD4， CD5， and CD25 and in a majority of cases also for CD2 and CD3 .

【28】**ANAPLASTIC LARGE CEll LYMPHOMA**

【29】**ALCL often involves the extranodal sites. In both ALK+and ALK- cases， large tumor cells show strong expression of CD30 and most often aberrant expression of pan-T-cell antigens. Some cases may display “null cell"-type phenotype with negative expression of all pan-T-cell markers 删除2:<u>(CD2， CD3， CD5， and CD7； see Chapter 22 for details)</u>.**

【112】页码间删除-1:<u>**LUNG**</u>

【113】页码间删除-1:<u>**INTRODUCTION**</u>

【114】Primary lymphomas of the lung are rare and majority of them are represented by marginal zone lymphoma \[MZL； mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT type)\]， followed by diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL)， and sporadic cases of Hodgkin lymphoma (HL)， mantle cell lymphoma(MCL)， follicular lymphoma (FL)， B-cell chronic lympho-cytic leukemia (B-CLL)， anaplastic large cell lymphoma(ALCL)， and peripheral T-cell lymphoma (PTCL)， not otherwise specified 通用删除6(英):<u>\[1-6\]</u>.

【115】页码间删除-1:<u>**MZL (MALT TYPE)**</u>

【116】Pulmonary MZL (MALT lymphoma) may be associated with Sjogren's syndrome， rheumatoid arthritis， and other immu-nologic abnormalities. Low levels of monoclonal serum pro-teins are common.

【117】页码间删除-1:<u>**Morphology**</u>

MALT lymphoma of the lung shows a multifocal pattern of growth ， starting as a perilymphan-gitic infiltrate with eventual formation of infiltrative and|删除0换行|destructive masseswithin pulmonary parenchyma often extending into visceral pleura 通用删除6(英):<u>\[1，4，5，7-11\]</u>. Histologic fea-tures are similar to those observed in other locations. The lymphoid infiltrate shows predominance of small- to occa-sionally medium-sized lymphocytes and scattered larger cells with centroblastic morphology. The lymphoid cells often dis-play a typical monocytoid appearance. Plasma cells are pres-ent at various proportions and are often monotypic. Reactive germinal centers are usually present and show features of colonization by neoplastic lymphocytes. Lymphoepithelial lesions are common and neoplastic B cells may protrude into the lumen of the bronchi. MALT lymphoma may be accompanied by pleural effusion and involvement of the peri-bronchial or mediastinal lymph nodes. Pulmonary MALT lymphomas may be associated with stromal amyloid deposi-tion 通用删除6(英):<u>\[12，13\]</u>.

【119】页码间删除-1:<u>**Immunophenotype**</u>

【148】**Temporal Lobe Pathology**

【149】**Glioma， arteriovenous malformations， cavernous heman-giomas， hematomas or traumatic sears all cause complex partial seizures. The advent of MRI scanning with associ-ated volumetry of medial temporal lobe structures and the hippocampal formation as well as PET， SPECT， and MRI spectroscopy have provided a much better understanding of congenital abnormalities that underlie these conditions. There are a variety of migrational disorders that can be diagnosed by MRI scanning. These are caused by abnormal neuronal migrations of germinal plate neurons from the ventricle to the cortex and disrupted gyration and apoptosis of the neu-rons that have migrated. Nests of subependymal neurons are noted in the frontal， parietal and temporal white matter， in periventricular heterotopia. This may be seen unilaterally or bilaterally. The walls of the ventricles demonstrate nodules of subependymal neurons that have not migrated. Radial glial fibers from the ventricles to the cortex may be seen in tuberous sclerosis. Migration of these subependymal cells occurs in the 20-22nd week of gestations. A double cortex or thickened band heterotopia may be seen in those patients who have suffered failure of apoptosis and no remodeling of the cortex. The extremes of this condition are schizencephaly and lissencephaly. Failure of architectural remodeling may be seen in focal cortical dysplasia in which the orderly laminar structure of the cortex is disrupted. These focal dysplasias may be further characterized as a laminar heterotopia， sim-plified gyral pattern and focal microgyri. There are genetic syndromes with X-linked heterotopias and double cortex as well as sporadic genetic forms of abnormal migrational patterns. Agyria， polymicrogyria， macrogyria， and sublobar dysplasias have all been seen with complex partial seizures of temporal lobe origin. Focal cortical dysplasia may demon-strate abnormal giant neurons and balloon cells in a addition to the dysmyelination.**

【150】**The syndrome of medial temporal sclerosis is suspected if the patient has suffered prolonged febrile convulsions as a child. Medial temporal sclerosis may also be seen in con-junction with migrational defects a situation known as dual pathology. Bilateral anatomic abnormalities with a unilateral temporal lobe seizure focus have been seen in 20-40% of pa-tients with medial temporal lobe sclerosis. Mesial temporal sclerosis may extend throughout the temporal lobe and in-volves both the cortex and white matter. The temporal pole is frequently atrophic ipsilateral to the side of seizure onset in seizure patients.**

【151】**Bilateral parasagittal， parieto-occipital and episylvian， polymicrogyria as well as hemi megacephaly are other pat-temns of cortical dysplasia. These migrational defects are frequently associated with contralateral hemiasymmetry of the arms， face and leg. If the face is obviously involved， the process is termed the Parry-Romberg Syndrome. If the seizure disorder is associated with an intrauterine stroke of a vascular territory， severe trauma a porencephalic cyst or arteriovenous malformation， the contralateral hemiatrophy is severe and obvious. Limbic encephalitis not associated with neoplasm is a cause of temporal lobe seizures. Perivascular lymphocytic infiltration is noted. The CSF demonstrates a mild pleocytosis. IgG is demonstrated in 20% of patients and oligoclonal bands in 50%. The differential diagnosis includes Rasmussen’s encephalitis， Hashimoto’s disease， SLE and paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis.**

【152】**Perivascular clustering and cortical neuronal clustering(micro dyseneias) is associated with mossy fiber sprouting into the dentate supragranularlayer. Congenital porencephaly may absorb concordant with hippocampal sclerosis.**

【148】**Temporal Lobe Pathology**

【149】**Glioma， arteriovenous malformations， cavernous heman-giomas， hematomas or traumatic sears all cause complex partial seizures. The advent of MRI scanning with associ-ated volumetry of medial temporal lobe structures and the hippocampal formation as well as PET， SPECT， and MRI spectroscopy have provided a much better understanding of congenital abnormalities that underlie these conditions. There are a variety of migrational disorders that can be diagnosed by MRI scanning. These are caused by abnormal neuronal migrations of germinal plate neurons from the ventricle to the cortex and disrupted gyration and apoptosis of the neu-rons that have migrated. Nests of subependymal neurons are noted in the frontal， parietal and temporal white matter， in periventricular heterotopia. This may be seen unilaterally or bilaterally. The walls of the ventricles demonstrate nodules of subependymal neurons that have not migrated. Radial glial fibers from the ventricles to the cortex may be seen in tuberous sclerosis. Migration of these subependymal cells occurs in the 20-22nd week of gestations. A double cortex or thickened band heterotopia may be seen in those patients who have suffered failure of apoptosis and no remodeling of the cortex. The extremes of this condition are schizencephaly and lissencephaly. Failure of architectural remodeling may be seen in focal cortical dysplasia in which the orderly laminar structure of the cortex is disrupted. These focal dysplasias may be further characterized as a laminar heterotopia， sim-plified gyral pattern and focal microgyri. There are genetic syndromes with X-linked heterotopias and double cortex as well as sporadic genetic forms of abnormal migrational patterns. Agyria， polymicrogyria， macrogyria， and sublobar dysplasias have all been seen with complex partial seizures of temporal lobe origin. Focal cortical dysplasia may demon-strate abnormal giant neurons and balloon cells in a addition to the dysmyelination.**

【150】**The syndrome of medial temporal sclerosis is suspected if the patient has suffered prolonged febrile convulsions as a child. Medial temporal sclerosis may also be seen in con-junction with migrational defects a situation known as dual pathology. Bilateral anatomic abnormalities with a unilateral temporal lobe seizure focus have been seen in 20-40% of pa-tients with medial temporal lobe sclerosis. Mesial temporal sclerosis may extend throughout the temporal lobe and in-volves both the cortex and white matter. The temporal pole is frequently atrophic ipsilateral to the side of seizure onset in seizure patients.**

【151】**Bilateral parasagittal， parieto-occipital and episylvian， polymicrogyria as well as hemi megacephaly are other pat-temns of cortical dysplasia. These migrational defects are frequently associated with contralateral hemiasymmetry of the arms， face and leg. If the face is obviously involved， the process is termed the Parry-Romberg Syndrome. If the seizure disorder is associated with an intrauterine stroke of a vascular territory， severe trauma a porencephalic cyst or arteriovenous malformation， the contralateral hemiatrophy is severe and obvious. Limbic encephalitis not associated with neoplasm is a cause of temporal lobe seizures. Perivascular lymphocytic infiltration is noted. The CSF demonstrates a mild pleocytosis. IgG is demonstrated in 20% of patients and oligoclonal bands in 50%. The differential diagnosis includes Rasmussen’s encephalitis， Hashimoto’s disease， SLE and paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis.**

【152】**Perivascular clustering and cortical neuronal clustering(micro dyseneias) is associated with mossy fiber sprouting into the dentate supragranularlayer. Congenital porencephaly may absorb concordant with hippocampal sclerosis.**

【148】**Temporal Lobe Pathology**

【149】**Glioma， arteriovenous malformations， cavernous heman-giomas， hematomas or traumatic sears all cause complex partial seizures. The advent of MRI scanning with associ-ated volumetry of medial temporal lobe structures and the hippocampal formation as well as PET， SPECT， and MRI spectroscopy have provided a much better understanding of congenital abnormalities that underlie these conditions. There are a variety of migrational disorders that can be diagnosed by MRI scanning. These are caused by abnormal neuronal migrations of germinal plate neurons from the ventricle to the cortex and disrupted gyration and apoptosis of the neu-rons that have migrated. Nests of subependymal neurons are noted in the frontal， parietal and temporal white matter， in periventricular heterotopia. This may be seen unilaterally or bilaterally. The walls of the ventricles demonstrate nodules of subependymal neurons that have not migrated. Radial glial fibers from the ventricles to the cortex may be seen in tuberous sclerosis. Migration of these subependymal cells occurs in the 20-22nd week of gestations. A double cortex or thickened band heterotopia may be seen in those patients who have suffered failure of apoptosis and no remodeling of the cortex. The extremes of this condition are schizencephaly and lissencephaly. Failure of architectural remodeling may be seen in focal cortical dysplasia in which the orderly laminar structure of the cortex is disrupted. These focal dysplasias may be further characterized as a laminar heterotopia， sim-plified gyral pattern and focal microgyri. There are genetic syndromes with X-linked heterotopias and double cortex as well as sporadic genetic forms of abnormal migrational patterns. Agyria， polymicrogyria， macrogyria， and sublobar dysplasias have all been seen with complex partial seizures of temporal lobe origin. Focal cortical dysplasia may demon-strate abnormal giant neurons and balloon cells in a addition to the dysmyelination.**

【150】**The syndrome of medial temporal sclerosis is suspected if the patient has suffered prolonged febrile convulsions as a child. Medial temporal sclerosis may also be seen in con-junction with migrational defects a situation known as dual pathology. Bilateral anatomic abnormalities with a unilateral temporal lobe seizure focus have been seen in 20-40% of pa-tients with medial temporal lobe sclerosis. Mesial temporal sclerosis may extend throughout the temporal lobe and in-volves both the cortex and white matter. The temporal pole is frequently atrophic ipsilateral to the side of seizure onset in seizure patients.**

【151】**Bilateral parasagittal， parieto-occipital and episylvian， polymicrogyria as well as hemi megacephaly are other pat-temns of cortical dysplasia. These migrational defects are frequently associated with contralateral hemiasymmetry of the arms， face and leg. If the face is obviously involved， the process is termed the Parry-Romberg Syndrome. If the seizure disorder is associated with an intrauterine stroke of a vascular territory， severe trauma a porencephalic cyst or arteriovenous malformation， the contralateral hemiatrophy is severe and obvious. Limbic encephalitis not associated with neoplasm is a cause of temporal lobe seizures. Perivascular lymphocytic infiltration is noted. The CSF demonstrates a mild pleocytosis. IgG is demonstrated in 20% of patients and oligoclonal bands in 50%. The differential diagnosis includes Rasmussen’s encephalitis， Hashimoto’s disease， SLE and paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis.**

【152】**Perivascular clustering and cortical neuronal clustering(micro dyseneias) is associated with mossy fiber sprouting into the dentate supragranularlayer. Congenital porencephaly may absorb concordant with hippocampal sclerosis.**

【148】**Temporal Lobe Pathology**

【149】**Glioma， arteriovenous malformations， cavernous heman-giomas， hematomas or traumatic sears all cause complex partial seizures. The advent of MRI scanning with associ-ated volumetry of medial temporal lobe structures and the hippocampal formation as well as PET， SPECT， and MRI spectroscopy have provided a much better understanding of congenital abnormalities that underlie these conditions. There are a variety of migrational disorders that can be diagnosed by MRI scanning. These are caused by abnormal neuronal migrations of germinal plate neurons from the ventricle to the cortex and disrupted gyration and apoptosis of the neu-rons that have migrated. Nests of subependymal neurons are noted in the frontal， parietal and temporal white matter， in periventricular heterotopia. This may be seen unilaterally or bilaterally. The walls of the ventricles demonstrate nodules of subependymal neurons that have not migrated. Radial glial fibers from the ventricles to the cortex may be seen in tuberous sclerosis. Migration of these subependymal cells occurs in the 20-22nd week of gestations. A double cortex or thickened band heterotopia may be seen in those patients who have suffered failure of apoptosis and no remodeling of the cortex. The extremes of this condition are schizencephaly and lissencephaly. Failure of architectural remodeling may be seen in focal cortical dysplasia in which the orderly laminar structure of the cortex is disrupted. These focal dysplasias may be further characterized as a laminar heterotopia， sim-plified gyral pattern and focal microgyri. There are genetic syndromes with X-linked heterotopias and double cortex as well as sporadic genetic forms of abnormal migrational patterns. Agyria， polymicrogyria， macrogyria， and sublobar dysplasias have all been seen with complex partial seizures of temporal lobe origin. Focal cortical dysplasia may demon-strate abnormal giant neurons and balloon cells in a addition to the dysmyelination.**

【150】**The syndrome of medial temporal sclerosis is suspected if the patient has suffered prolonged febrile convulsions as a child. Medial temporal sclerosis may also be seen in con-junction with migrational defects a situation known as dual pathology. Bilateral anatomic abnormalities with a unilateral temporal lobe seizure focus have been seen in 20-40% of pa-tients with medial temporal lobe sclerosis. Mesial temporal sclerosis may extend throughout the temporal lobe and in-volves both the cortex and white matter. The temporal pole is frequently atrophic ipsilateral to the side of seizure onset in seizure patients.**

【151】**Bilateral parasagittal， parieto-occipital and episylvian， polymicrogyria as well as hemi megacephaly are other pat-temns of cortical dysplasia. These migrational defects are frequently associated with contralateral hemiasymmetry of the arms， face and leg. If the face is obviously involved， the process is termed the Parry-Romberg Syndrome. If the seizure disorder is associated with an intrauterine stroke of a vascular territory， severe trauma a porencephalic cyst or arteriovenous malformation， the contralateral hemiatrophy is severe and obvious. Limbic encephalitis not associated with neoplasm is a cause of temporal lobe seizures. Perivascular lymphocytic infiltration is noted. The CSF demonstrates a mild pleocytosis. IgG is demonstrated in 20% of patients and oligoclonal bands in 50%. The differential diagnosis includes Rasmussen’s encephalitis， Hashimoto’s disease， SLE and paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis.**

There are a variety of migrational disorders that can be diagnosed by MRI scanning. These are caused by abnormal neuronal migrations of germinal plate neurons from the ventricle to the cortex and disrupted gyration and apoptosis of the neu-rons that have migrated. Nests of subependymal neurons are noted in the frontal， parietal and temporal white matter， in periventricular heterotopia. This may be seen unilaterally or bilaterally. The walls of the ventricles demonstrate nodules of subependymal neurons that have not migrated. Radial glial fibers from the ventricles to the cortex may be seen in tuberous sclerosis. Migration of these subependymal cells occurs in the 20-22nd week of gestations. A double cortex or thickened band heterotopia may be seen in those patients who have suffered failure of apoptosis and no remodeling of the cortex. The extremes of this condition are schizencephaly and lissencephaly. Failure of architectural remodeling may be seen in focal cortical dysplasia in which the orderly laminar structure of the cortex is disrupted. These focal dysplasias may be further characterized as a laminar heterotopia， sim-plified gyral pattern and focal microgyri. There are genetic syndromes with X-linked heterotopias and double cortex as well as sporadic genetic forms of abnormal migrational patterns. Agyria， polymicrogyria， macrogyria， and sublobar dysplasias have all been seen with complex partial seizures of temporal lobe origin. Focal cortical dysplasia may demon-strate abnormal giant neurons and balloon cells in a addition to the dysmyelination.**

【150】**The syndrome of medial temporal sclerosis is suspected if the patient has suffered prolonged febrile convulsions as a child. Medial temporal sclerosis may also be seen in con-junction with migrational defects a situation known as dual pathology. Bilateral anatomic abnormalities with a unilateral temporal lobe seizure focus have been seen in 20-40% of pa-tients with medial temporal lobe sclerosis. 【8】ICHEN simplex chronicus and hypertrophic lichen planus are pruritic conditions， both of which show histologic signs of persisteni rubbing. In fact， hypertrophic lichen planus is lichen simplex chronicus superimposed upon ordinary lesions of lichen planus. Common to both conditions are compact orthokeratosis， irregular psoriasiform hyper-plasia， focal hypergranulosis， coarse collagen bundles arranged in vertical streaks in a thickened papillary dermis， a superficial perivascular inflam-matory-cell infiltrate of lymphocytes and histiocytes， widely dilated vascular spaces oriented perpendicularly to the skin surface， an increased number of melanophages and fibroblasts in the upper part of the dermis， follicular dilation with plugging by cornified cells， and hypergranulosis within follicu-lar infundibula.

【9】In lichen simplex chronicus， all of the described changes result from persistent rubbing. There are no features of lichen planus. The histologic characteristics of persistent rubbing of skin in the hyperkeratotic type of lichen simplex chronicus are compact orthokeratosis with abundant para-keratosis， hypergranulosis， irregular psoriasiform hyperplasia， and， some-times， coarse collagen bundles in vertical streaks in a thickened papillary dermis. In short， all of the components of the skin above the reticular der-mis become thickened. Scratching of these lesions of lichen simplex chronicus may result in erosions， ulcerations， crusts， and focal necrosis of the upper part of the epidermis. In hypertrophic lichen planus， in addition to changes of chronic rubbing， there is relatively little parakeratosis， the granular zone is thickened in wedge-shaped fashion (cspecially prominent within dilated infundibula). A lichenoid infiltrate obscures the dermo-epidermal junction focally at the rounded bases of rete ridges (with sparing of the tips of dermal papillae)， and there is vacuolar alteration with necrotic keralinocytes in the basal portion of the epidermis.

【10】Lesions of prurigo nodularis and its excoriated， ulcerated form， namely， picker's nodule， result from persistent rubbing (and scratching)； they represent localized， nodular variants of lichen simplex chronicus. Rather than persistent rubbing of a broad arca to produce a pladuc of lichen simplex chronicus， a smaller spot of skin is assaulted with a blunt object， usually a finger tip or knuckle， to produce a nodule. As a rule， the initiating cause of the pruritus is not identified by history or histologic analysis. Prurigo nodularis occurs mostly in middle-aged persons， especially women. There usually are a few nodules， mostly situated on anatomic sites easily accessible to fingers and fingernails， such as the extensor parts of the fore-arms， the thighs， and the legs. The course is protracted.

【11】There are two basic histologic patterns that result from chronic rub-bing. When the cornificd laver is markedly thickened and completely ortho-keratotic， like that normally present only on palms or soles， we term the lesion the hyperkeratotic type of lichen simplex chronicus. These lesions appear commonly on certain anatomic sites， such as on a lip (as keratosis oris)， on the perianal mucosal-epidermal junction (as a consequence of pru-ritus ani)， on the genitals， and on the scalp. In the second type of lichen simplex， encountered more comionly， the changes in the cornified layer are less impressive than those in the papillary dermis. In this second type， the papillary dermis is markedly thickened by altered collagen， both coars-cned and oriented perpendicularly to the surface of the epidermis. Some-times both patterns are present in a single biopsy specimen. As a rule， however， the hyperkeratotic type of lichen simplex chronicus is not associ-ated with coarse collagen bundles in vertical streaks in a thickened papillary dermis.

【12】Hypertrophic lichen planus is merely one of many manifestations of lichen planus； in this case， in addition to lichen planus there are the changes caused by superimposition of persistent rubbing. Individual lesions are scaly， hyperpigmented plaques or dome-shaped nodules. Although lichen planus is characteristically pruritic， rubbing sufficient to produce the addi-tional changes of lichen simplex chronicus is seen rarely， and then with greater frequency on the legs， especially near the ankles. Other variants of lichen planus include the bullous and atrophic types， those of the nails and mucous membranes， and lichen planopilaris.

【13】Lichen planus， in its classic histologic form， has epidermal hyperplasia with jagged rete ridges， orthokeratosis， and a dense lichenoid， predomi-nantly lymphocytic infiltrate that obscures the dermo-epidermal junctione S1：venly across the entire lesion. With the superimposition of persistent rub-bing， histologic changes of lichen simplex alter the basic pattern of lichen planus. The epidermal hyperplasia becomes even more marked， the bases of the rete ridges become rounded and lose their jagged outline， small foci of parakeratosis may be present in the hyperkeratotic cornified layer， and the band-like infiltrate of lymphocytes develops skip areas， i.e.， sparing the tips of the dermal papillae where there is more coarsening of the collagen bun-dles.

【14】The changes of lichen simplex added to lichen planus are much the same as lichen simplex superimposed on macular amyloidosis to produce lichen amvloidosis.

【15】Clinically， lichen simplex chronicus is a plaque characterized by accen-tuation of normal skin markings， hyperpigmentation， and a keratotic sur-face. Hypertrophic lichen planus consists of purplish papules， nodules， and plaques that are markedly keratotic， especially in the skin overlying the anterior tibia， which is casily accessible to persistent rubhing by a heel.

【41】**_Lichen Sclerosus et Atrophicus_ _Chronic Radiation Dermatitis_**

LICHEN sclerosus et atrophicus and chronic radi-|删除0换行|ation dermatitis are both fibrosing dermatitides that may closely resemble one another when viewed with the scanning objective of the conventional light microscope. Both diseases are characterized by hyperkeratosis， vacuo-lar alteration of the basal layer， subepidermal clefts， sclerosis and fibrin deposition in the dermis， and dilated dermal vascular spaces with a sur-rounding infiltrate of inflammatory cells， extravasated erythrocytes， and pigment-laden macrophages. Both lesions are rubbed commonly， producing compact orthokeratosis. Major features that enable the two conditions to be differentiated are changes in the dermis in lichen sclerosus et atrophicus that arc confined to the papillary dermis， i.e.， there are no changes in the collagen of the reticular dermis. Furthermore， in lichen sclerosus， the ostia of epithelial structures of adnexa are plugged by cornified cells. In contrast， in chronic radiation dermatitis， there is sclerosis at all levels of the dermis and occasionally of the subcutis， and ostia of adnexal structures are not plugged. In addition， there are many more atypical keratinocytes， melano-cytes， and fibroblasts in chronic radiodermatitis， and the dilated blood ves-sels have abnormal shapes and atypical endothelial cells.

【43】Lichen sclerosus et atrophicus， in contrast to chronic radiation derma-titis， is often pruritic rather than painful and most often affects the external genitalia of women. Lichen sclerosus may also affect the genitalia of men， and， when on the glans， is termed balanitis xerotica obliterans. Regardless of location (and it may be extragenital on nearly any cutaneous site)， lesions are hypopigmented papules or plaques showing atrophy characterized by“cigarette-paper”wrinkling， follicular plugging， and telangiectases. As with chronic radiation dermatitis， although with far less frequency， squamous cell carcinomas may develop within lesions of lichen sclerosus et atrophicus on the vulva.

【44】Chronic radiation dermatitis usually occurs in one of two circum-stances. The more common type is the result of radiation therapy， most often administered in fractionated doses for treatment of cutaneous malig-nancies. The second type of chronic radiation dermatitis follows long-term exposures at lower doses and is usually an occupational disease， most often seen in careless dentists and dental assistants who take radiographs without precautions， Patterns of radiation exposure similar to those ofoccupational exposure have been used therapeutically for the treatment of acne， epilation of excess hair， “neurodermatitis，" recalcitrant verrucae， and other benign conditions of the skin.

【45】**Dermatitis from high doses of radiation given over a short period of time， i.e.， as a means of therapy， are seen at the site of treatment beginning severalyears after the initial therapy. The clinical changes are atrophic scars， loss of hair， telangiectases， and hyper- and hypopigmentation. Occu-pational radiation dermatitis is seen most often on the hands， which show drying and scaling， sparse hair， flattening of skin lines， verrucous keratoses， and painful ulcerations. Some cases， usually those on the face， eventuate in scleroderma-like bird-nose facies and warty keratoses. Radiation keratoses， squamous-cell carcinomas， and sarcomas occur with increased frequency in both types of radiation-induced dermatitis.**

【46】**The clinical features of hardness， whiteness， telangiectases， and atro-phy， shared by lichen sclerosus and chronic radiation dermatitis， have simi-lar histologic aspects in both diseases. The hardness results from the altered， sclerotic connective tissue in the dermis. The whiteness resuits from loss of epidermal melanin， as well as from sclerosis in the upper part of the dermis. Telangiectases are dilated vessels， often in increased numbers， within the dermis made all the more visible by epidermal thinning. Atrophy is charac-terized histologically by flattening and thinning of the epidermis but rnostly by flattening of the normal pattern of rete ridges and dermal papillae. If a biopsy specimen is superficial， the two conditions may be indistinguishable histologically， because only those features common to both diseases may be seen in the specimen.**

【71】**_Chronic Urticaria_**

【72】CHRONIC urticaria and the urticarial stage of

【73】bullous pemphigoid have several histologic features in common， such as a superficial and mid- or deep dermalperivascular and interstitial mixed-cell infiltrate of neutrophils and eosinophils in addition to lymphocytes and histiocytes， edema in the dermis， and dilated blood vessels. The cardinal features that enable chronic urticaria to be differentiated from urticarial lesions of pemphigoid are that the infiltrate is sparse， there is more edema in the reticular than in the papillary dermis， and neutrophils tend to out-number eosinophils in the inflammatory-cell infiltrate. In contrast， the infil-trate in the urticarial stage of pemphigoid is moderately dense and concen-trated in the papillary dermis， the edema in the papillary dermis is greater than that in the reticular dermis， and eosinophils outnumber neutrophils in the inflammatory-cell infiltrate.

【74】Urticaria is a commonly encountered clinical problem. It has been esti-mated that 15 to 20% of people experience at least one episode of urticaria in their lifetimes. Clinically， a wheal is an edernatous， irregularly shaped， pinkish papule or plaque that blanches upon pressure and itches， often intensely. Individual wheals are transient， not usually persisting for more than 24 hours. If an individual hive persists for longer than 36 hours， it is probably not true urticaria， but rather is part of an urticaria-like process such as an urticarial drug reaction or the urticarial stage of bullous pemphi-goid.

【75】Acute and chronic urticaria are defined by the duration of the entire process rather than by the duration of individual hives. Urticaria is said to be chronic if the process lasts for more than 6 weeks. In reality， hives that come and go for more than a few days are likely to persist for much longer than that， in some patients even for years. The individual wheals in both acute and chronic urticaria tend to disappear in less than 24 hours. Acute urticaria， which is often explosive in onset and may be associated with angioedema， is almost always an allergic response， and the cause is usually identified by the patient， e.g.， an ingestant， inhalant， or injected substance. In contrast， the cause of longlasting， i.e.， chronic， urticaria is practically never identifiable by either patient or physician， and it may be that the mechanism for it is not related to allergy. Hives of acute urticaria respond quickly and effectively to various antihistamines or to systemic corticoste-roids； those of chronic urticaria are not controlled invariably by any medica-tion， although H-1 blocking antihistamines such as hydroxyzine are some-times palliative.

【76】Unlike individual lesions of true hives， the urticarial lesions of pemphi-goid persist for more than 36 hours； some lesions may be surmounted by tense vesicles or bullae. Patients afflicted with pemphigoid tend to be older， i.e.， in their seventh and cighth decades， than those with true urticaria， and the lesions are often accompanied by evidence of excoriations. The urticarial lesions of pemphigoid often assume arcuate， annular， gyrate， and serpigi-nous configurations， Rarely， the lesions disappearr“spontaneously”and completely， but as a rule， their appearance presages the coming of more typical blisters of pemphigoid. True urticaria never vesiculates.

【77】The histologic findings in true urticaria and in urticarial lesions of bullous pemphigoid are quite specific. A sparse superficial and deep peri-vascular and interstitial mixed-cell infiltrate containing eosinophils and neutrophils is virtually diagnostic of chronic urticaria. Urticarial allergic eruptions caused especially by drugs are indistinguishable histologically from the lesions of chronic urticaria. Differentiation histologically of acute urticaria from chronic urticaria is accomplishable. Lesions of acute urti-caria tend to have mostly lymphocytes in the sparse infiltrate and few eosin-ophils. Furthermore， neutrophils are usually absent from lesions of acute urticaria，

【78】A moderately dense superficial and deep perivascular and interstitial infiltrate that is also moderately dense and lichenoid in the papillary dermis and is associated with innumerable eosinophils is virtually diagnostic of the urticarial stage of pemphigoid. Herpes gestationis， one of the pruritic papu-lar and vesicular eruptions of pregnancy， is indistinguishable histologically from bullous pemphigoid. Urticarial reactions to insect bites also must be differentiated from urticarial lesions of pemphigoid. Such reactions are usu-ally associated with a wedge-shaped infiltrate that is not at all dense in the papillary dermis.

The clinical changes are atrophic scars， loss of hair， telangiectases， and hyper- and hypopigmentation. Occu-pational radiation dermatitis is seen most often on the hands， which show drying and scaling， sparse hair， flattening of skin lines， verrucous keratoses， and painful ulcerations. Some cases， usually those on the face， eventuate in scleroderma-like bird-nose facies and warty keratoses. Radiation keratoses， squamous-cell carcinomas， and sarcomas occur with increased frequency in both types of radiation-induced dermatitis.**

【46】**The clinical features of hardness， whiteness， telangiectases， and atro-phy， shared by lichen sclerosus and chronic radiation dermatitis， have simi-lar histologic aspects in both diseases. The hardness results from the altered， sclerotic connective tissue in the dermis. The whiteness resuits from loss of epidermal melanin， as well as from sclerosis in the upper part of the dermis. Telangiectases are dilated vessels， often in increased numbers， within the dermis made all the more visible by epidermal thinning. Atrophy is charac-terized histologically by flattening and thinning of the epidermis but rnostly by flattening of the normal pattern of rete ridges and dermal papillae. If a biopsy specimen is superficial， the two conditions may be indistinguishable histologically， because only those features common to both diseases may be seen in the specimen.**

【47】**10\. Chronic Urticaria vs Urticarial Stage of Pemphigoid**

【48】**_Chronic Urticaria_ _Urticarial Stage of Pemphigoid_**

【71】**_Chronic Urticaria_**

【72】CHRONIC urticaria and the urticarial stage of

【73】bullous pemphigoid have several histologic features in common， such as a superficial and mid- or deep dermalperivascular and interstitial mixed-cell infiltrate of neutrophils and eosinophils in addition to lymphocytes and histiocytes， edema in the dermis， and dilated blood vessels. The cardinal features that enable chronic urticaria to be differentiated from urticarial lesions of pemphigoid are that the infiltrate is sparse， there is more edema in the reticular than in the papillary dermis， and neutrophils tend to out-number eosinophils in the inflammatory-cell infiltrate. In contrast， the infil-trate in the urticarial stage of pemphigoid is moderately dense and concen-trated in the papillary dermis， the edema in the papillary dermis is greater than that in the reticular dermis， and eosinophils outnumber neutrophils in the inflammatory-cell infiltrate.

【74】Urticaria is a commonly encountered clinical problem. It has been esti-mated that 15 to 20% of people experience at least one episode of urticaria in their lifetimes. Clinically， a wheal is an edernatous， irregularly shaped， pinkish papule or plaque that blanches upon pressure and itches， often intensely. Individual wheals are transient， not usually persisting for more than 24 hours. If an individual hive persists for longer than 36 hours， it is probably not true urticaria， but rather is part of an urticaria-like process such as an urticarial drug reaction or the urticarial stage of bullous pemphi-goid.

【75】Acute and chronic urticaria are defined by the duration of the entire process rather than by the duration of individual hives. Urticaria is said to be chronic if the process lasts for more than 6 weeks. In reality， hives that come and go for more than a few days are likely to persist for much longer than that， in some patients even for years. The individual wheals in both acute and chronic urticaria tend to disappear in less than 24 hours. Acute urticaria， which is often explosive in onset and may be associated with angioedema， is almost always an allergic response， and the cause is usually identified by the patient， e.g.， an ingestant， inhalant， or injected substance. In contrast， the cause of longlasting， i.e.， chronic， urticaria is practically never identifiable by either patient or physician， and it may be that the mechanism for it is not related to allergy. Hives of acute urticaria respond quickly and effectively to various antihistamines or to systemic corticoste-roids； those of chronic urticaria are not controlled invariably by any medica-tion， although H-1 blocking antihistamines such as hydroxyzine are some-times palliative.

【76】Unlike individual lesions of true hives， the urticarial lesions of pemphi-goid persist for more than 36 hours； some lesions may be surmounted by tense vesicles or bullae. Patients afflicted with pemphigoid tend to be older， i.e.， in their seventh and cighth decades， than those with true urticaria， and the lesions are often accompanied by evidence of excoriations. The urticarial lesions of pemphigoid often assume arcuate， annular， gyrate， and serpigi-nous configurations， Rarely， the lesions disappearr“spontaneously”and completely， but as a rule， their appearance presages the coming of more typical blisters of pemphigoid. True urticaria never vesiculates.

【77】The histologic findings in true urticaria and in urticarial lesions of bullous pemphigoid are quite specific. A sparse superficial and deep peri-vascular and interstitial mixed-cell infiltrate containing eosinophils and neutrophils is virtually diagnostic of chronic urticaria. Urticarial allergic eruptions caused especially by drugs are indistinguishable histologically from the lesions of chronic urticaria. Differentiation histologically of acute urticaria from chronic urticaria is accomplishable. Lesions of acute urti-caria tend to have mostly lymphocytes in the sparse infiltrate and few eosin-ophils. Furthermore， neutrophils are usually absent from lesions of acute urticaria，

【78】A moderately dense superficial and deep perivascular and interstitial infiltrate that is also moderately dense and lichenoid in the papillary dermis and is associated with innumerable eosinophils is virtually diagnostic of the urticarial stage of pemphigoid. Herpes gestationis， one of the pruritic papu-lar and vesicular eruptions of pregnancy， is indistinguishable histologically from bullous pemphigoid. Urticarial reactions to insect bites also must be differentiated from urticarial lesions of pemphigoid. Such reactions are usu-ally associated with a wedge-shaped infiltrate that is not at all dense in the papillary dermis.

【18】页码间删除-1:<u>44. Rosacea Fulminans
=====================</u>

【19】人名段删除-1:<u>Cristina Caridi 1 and Joshua A. Zeichner 1</u>

删除10:<u>(1)|删除序号换行|Department of Dermatology, Mt. Sinai School of Medicine, New York, NY, USA</u>

【21】Abstract

【22】Rosacea fulminans is a rare dermatosis characterized by the sudden onset of coalescing nodules and draining sinuses on the face, typically affecting young women. First reported in 1940 by the name pyoderma faciale, it was thought to be an infiltrative pyoderma, possibly caused by tuberculosis, despite being unable to identify a cause 通用删除6(英):<u>\[1\]</u>. It was not until 1992 that it was suggested that the condition was a form of rosacea, as all patients also experienced flushing and blushing along with the rapid and volatile onset. The term rosacea fulminans was then proposed 通用删除6(英):<u>\[2\]</u>. Despite research, a bacterial infection has not been shown to play a pathogenic role, further evidence that the condition is not a pyoderma, but rather a severe variant of rosacea 通用删除6(英):<u>\[3\]</u>. Rosacea fulminans has also been referred to as granulomatous rosacea.

【23】44.1 Introduction
-----------------

【24】Rosacea fulminans is a rare dermatosis characterized by the sudden onset of coalescing nodules and draining sinuses on the face, typically affecting young women. First reported in 1940 by the name pyoderma faciale, it was thought to be an infiltrative pyoderma, possibly caused by tuberculosis, despite being unable to identify a cause 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 \]</u>. It was not until 1992 that it was suggested that the condition was a form of rosacea, as all patients also experienced flushing and blushing along with the rapid and volatile onset. The term rosacea fulminans was then proposed 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 \]</u>. Despite research, a bacterial infection has not been shown to play a pathogenic role, further evidence that the condition is not a pyoderma, but rather a severe variant of rosacea 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>. Rosacea fulminans has also been referred to as granulomatous rosacea.

【25】44.2 Background
---------------

【26】The pathophysiology of rosacea fulminans is unknown. Hyperactivity of the innate immune system, severe emotional stress, hormonal changes (including those during pregnancy), and an association with inflammatory bowel disease have all been suggested 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 , 4 – 7 \]</u>. Helicobacter pylori bacteria have been identified in the gastric mucosa of patients with both rosacea and rosacea fulminans and is thought to stimulate production of vasoactive molecules, including prostaglandins, histamine, and various cytokines 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 8 , 9 \]</u>. A more in-depth review of the pathophysiology may be found in the rosacea chapter of this book.

【27】While extremely rare, rosacea fulminans is also assumed to be highly under-reported. Approximately 80 cases have been published since the 1940s. It occurs almost exclusively in healthy females in the second to third decades, but ages range from the teens into the 50s 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 , 2 \]</u>. There is no associated history with acne vulgaris 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>, but many patients may have an underlying diagnosis of rosacea 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 10 , 11 \]</u>.

【28】44.3 Clinical Presentation
--------------------------

【29】Rosacea fulminans is characterized by a sudden and explosive onset of large indurated erythematous plaques, nodules, papules, pustules, and draining sinuses restricted to the face . Patients generally has previously unblemished skin 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 , 2 , 11 \]</u>. The most severely affected areas of the face include the forehead, nasal bridge, cheeks, and chin 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>. Comedones are characteristically absent and the trunk is spared. Large abscesses may be interconnected through sinus tracts that discharge copious amounts of pus 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 \]</u>.

通用删除16(英):<u>Fig. 44.1|删除2图换行|An indurated, erythematous plaque on the left cheek of a woman in her 30s. Pustules and papules are evident within the plaque, and the patient complains of tenderness in the area (Photo credit: Joshua A. Zeichner, M.D.</u>

【31】No true prodrome exists prior to the onset of the disease. However, there are reports of patients who develop a sudden onset of excessive skin oiliness prior to the eruption 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 , 2 \]</u>. Patients are otherwise healthy, though some experience fatigue, discomfort, or general malaise. One patient has been reported to develop rosacea fulminans in association with erythema nodosum 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 12 \]</u>. Another report documented a case of severe ocular involvement presenting with blurry vision. Ophthalmologic exam revealed severe blepharitis with advanced keratitis and ocular perforation. While ocular involvement is common in traditional rosacea, it is not usually present in rosacea fulminans 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 11 \]</u>.

【32】Because of the particularly ferocious nature of the disease, patients may become depressed, anxious, and isolated because of the appearance 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 , 13 \]</u>. Scarring is common and expected and can range from minimal damage to keloids 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 , 14 \]</u>.

【33】44.4 Work-up
------------

【34】The diagnosis of rosacea fulminans is largely clinical, although supportive labs and a skin biopsy can be performed. Some patients have been documented to have a mild anemia, leukocytosis, increased erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR), elevated C-reactive protein (CRP), and positive rheumatoid factor and antinuclear antibodies 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 , 2 , 4 , 14 , 15 \]</u>. Skin biopsy reveals evidence of inflammation, with massive neutrophil infiltration in early stages and epithelioid cell granulomas in older lesions 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 4 , 12 , 16 \]</u>. Bacterial pathogens have not been consistently recovered, and most bacteria identified are commensal skin flora 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 , 3 \]</u>. Isolated cases report identification of Staphylococcus aureus and gram-negative bacteria 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 , 5 \]</u>.

【35】44.5 Treatment
--------------

【36】If untreated, rosacea fulminans generally resolves after approximately 1 year, although aggressive therapy is usually given to avoid the development of permanent scars. The most commonly effective treatment for rosacea fulminans is oral isotretinoin, usually in combination with oral corticosteroids to reduce the risk of an initial flare. Isotretinoin is typically dosed at 0.5 mg/kg/day for the first month then increased to 1 mg/kg/day at month 2, depending on the clinical appearance. Just as in acne vulgaris, the target cumulative dose is 120–150 mg/kg 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 , 4 , 11 , 17 – 19 \]</u>. Oral dapsone, oral and topical antibiotics, benzoyl peroxide, and topical and systemic corticosteroids, among others, have all been reported as well 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 , 5 , 6 , 18 , 20 \]</u>. Oral azithromycin has also been shown to be effective in a pregnant woman 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 15 \]</u>.

【37】Surgical interventions have been associated with poor outcomes. Incision and drainage of abscesses and sinus should not be performed as it can lead to excessive scarring 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 \]</u>. Early biopsy, however, can help correctly diagnose a patient early in the course of the disease and ultimately results in a more rapid treatment 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 16 \]</u>.

【38】44.6 Conclusion
---------------

【39】Rosacea fulminans is a rapidly occurring, severe facial dermatosis thought to be an extreme variant of rosacea. It results in significant scarring, both physically and emotionally. Early diagnosis with prompt treatment (usually with oral isotretinoin) is important to minimize long-term sequelae.

【72】Abstract

【73】Sarcoidosis is a multiorgan noninfectious granulomatous disease which can manifest in the integumentary system in a variety of ways, one of the most common being a maculopapular, acneiform facial eruption. Although sarcoidosis is generally categorized as a pulmonary disease, it involves the skin in approximately 25–30 % of cases. The etiology of sarcoidosis remains unknown. The polymorphic cutaneous lesions are grouped into specific and nonspecific lesions. 【21】Abstract

【22】Rosacea fulminans is a rare dermatosis characterized by the sudden onset of coalescing nodules and draining sinuses on the face, typically affecting young women. First reported in 1940 by the name pyoderma faciale, it was thought to be an infiltrative pyoderma, possibly caused by tuberculosis, despite being unable to identify a cause 通用删除6(英):<u>\[1\]</u>. It was not until 1992 that it was suggested that the condition was a form of rosacea, as all patients also experienced flushing and blushing along with the rapid and volatile onset. The term rosacea fulminans was then proposed 通用删除6(英):<u>\[2\]</u>. Despite research, a bacterial infection has not been shown to play a pathogenic role, further evidence that the condition is not a pyoderma, but rather a severe variant of rosacea 通用删除6(英):<u>\[3\]</u>. Rosacea fulminans has also been referred to as granulomatous rosacea.

【23】44.1 Introduction
-----------------

【24】Rosacea fulminans is a rare dermatosis characterized by the sudden onset of coalescing nodules and draining sinuses on the face, typically affecting young women. First reported in 1940 by the name pyoderma faciale, it was thought to be an infiltrative pyoderma, possibly caused by tuberculosis, despite being unable to identify a cause 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 \]</u>. It was not until 1992 that it was suggested that the condition was a form of rosacea, as all patients also experienced flushing and blushing along with the rapid and volatile onset. The term rosacea fulminans was then proposed 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 \]</u>. Despite research, a bacterial infection has not been shown to play a pathogenic role, further evidence that the condition is not a pyoderma, but rather a severe variant of rosacea 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>. Rosacea fulminans has also been referred to as granulomatous rosacea.

【25】44.2 Background
---------------

【26】The pathophysiology of rosacea fulminans is unknown. Hyperactivity of the innate immune system, severe emotional stress, hormonal changes (including those during pregnancy), and an association with inflammatory bowel disease have all been suggested 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 , 4 – 7 \]</u>. Helicobacter pylori bacteria have been identified in the gastric mucosa of patients with both rosacea and rosacea fulminans and is thought to stimulate production of vasoactive molecules, including prostaglandins, histamine, and various cytokines 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 8 , 9 \]</u>. A more in-depth review of the pathophysiology may be found in the rosacea chapter of this book.

【27】While extremely rare, rosacea fulminans is also assumed to be highly under-reported. Approximately 80 cases have been published since the 1940s. It occurs almost exclusively in healthy females in the second to third decades, but ages range from the teens into the 50s 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 , 2 \]</u>. There is no associated history with acne vulgaris 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>, but many patients may have an underlying diagnosis of rosacea 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 10 , 11 \]</u>.

【28】44.3 Clinical Presentation
--------------------------

【29】Rosacea fulminans is characterized by a sudden and explosive onset of large indurated erythematous plaques, nodules, papules, pustules, and draining sinuses restricted to the face . Patients generally has previously unblemished skin 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 , 2 , 11 \]</u>. The most severely affected areas of the face include the forehead, nasal bridge, cheeks, and chin 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>. Comedones are characteristically absent and the trunk is spared. Large abscesses may be interconnected through sinus tracts that discharge copious amounts of pus 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 \]</u>.

通用删除16(英):<u>Fig. 44.1|删除2图换行|An indurated, erythematous plaque on the left cheek of a woman in her 30s. Pustules and papules are evident within the plaque, and the patient complains of tenderness in the area (Photo credit: Joshua A. Zeichner, M.D.</u>

【31】No true prodrome exists prior to the onset of the disease. However, there are reports of patients who develop a sudden onset of excessive skin oiliness prior to the eruption 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 , 2 \]</u>. Patients are otherwise healthy, though some experience fatigue, discomfort, or general malaise. One patient has been reported to develop rosacea fulminans in association with erythema nodosum 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 12 \]</u>. Another report documented a case of severe ocular involvement presenting with blurry vision. Ophthalmologic exam revealed severe blepharitis with advanced keratitis and ocular perforation. While ocular involvement is common in traditional rosacea, it is not usually present in rosacea fulminans 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 11 \]</u>.

【32】Because of the particularly ferocious nature of the disease, patients may become depressed, anxious, and isolated because of the appearance 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 , 13 \]</u>. Scarring is common and expected and can range from minimal damage to keloids 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 , 14 \]</u>.

【33】44.4 Work-up
------------

【34】The diagnosis of rosacea fulminans is largely clinical, although supportive labs and a skin biopsy can be performed. Some patients have been documented to have a mild anemia, leukocytosis, increased erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR), elevated C-reactive protein (CRP), and positive rheumatoid factor and antinuclear antibodies 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 , 2 , 4 , 14 , 15 \]</u>. Skin biopsy reveals evidence of inflammation, with massive neutrophil infiltration in early stages and epithelioid cell granulomas in older lesions 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 4 , 12 , 16 \]</u>. Bacterial pathogens have not been consistently recovered, and most bacteria identified are commensal skin flora 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 , 3 \]</u>. Isolated cases report identification of Staphylococcus aureus and gram-negative bacteria 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 , 5 \]</u>.

【35】44.5 Treatment
--------------

【36】If untreated, rosacea fulminans generally resolves after approximately 1 year, although aggressive therapy is usually given to avoid the development of permanent scars. The most commonly effective treatment for rosacea fulminans is oral isotretinoin, usually in combination with oral corticosteroids to reduce the risk of an initial flare. Isotretinoin is typically dosed at 0.5 mg/kg/day for the first month then increased to 1 mg/kg/day at month 2, depending on the clinical appearance. Just as in acne vulgaris, the target cumulative dose is 120–150 mg/kg 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 , 4 , 11 , 17 – 19 \]</u>. Oral dapsone, oral and topical antibiotics, benzoyl peroxide, and topical and systemic corticosteroids, among others, have all been reported as well 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 , 5 , 6 , 18 , 20 \]</u>. Oral azithromycin has also been shown to be effective in a pregnant woman 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 15 \]</u>.

【37】Surgical interventions have been associated with poor outcomes. Incision and drainage of abscesses and sinus should not be performed as it can lead to excessive scarring 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 \]</u>. Early biopsy, however, can help correctly diagnose a patient early in the course of the disease and ultimately results in a more rapid treatment 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 16 \]</u>.

【38】44.6 Conclusion
---------------

【39】Rosacea fulminans is a rapidly occurring, severe facial dermatosis thought to be an extreme variant of rosacea. It results in significant scarring, both physically and emotionally. Early diagnosis with prompt treatment (usually with oral isotretinoin) is important to minimize long-term sequelae.

【21】Abstract

【22】Rosacea fulminans is a rare dermatosis characterized by the sudden onset of coalescing nodules and draining sinuses on the face, typically affecting young women. First reported in 1940 by the name pyoderma faciale, it was thought to be an infiltrative pyoderma, possibly caused by tuberculosis, despite being unable to identify a cause 通用删除6(英):<u>\[1\]</u>. It was not until 1992 that it was suggested that the condition was a form of rosacea, as all patients also experienced flushing and blushing along with the rapid and volatile onset. The term rosacea fulminans was then proposed 通用删除6(英):<u>\[2\]</u>. Despite research, a bacterial infection has not been shown to play a pathogenic role, further evidence that the condition is not a pyoderma, but rather a severe variant of rosacea 通用删除6(英):<u>\[3\]</u>. Rosacea fulminans has also been referred to as granulomatous rosacea.

【23】44.1 Introduction
-----------------

【24】Rosacea fulminans is a rare dermatosis characterized by the sudden onset of coalescing nodules and draining sinuses on the face, typically affecting young women. First reported in 1940 by the name pyoderma faciale, it was thought to be an infiltrative pyoderma, possibly caused by tuberculosis, despite being unable to identify a cause 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 \]</u>. It was not until 1992 that it was suggested that the condition was a form of rosacea, as all patients also experienced flushing and blushing along with the rapid and volatile onset. The term rosacea fulminans was then proposed 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 \]</u>. Despite research, a bacterial infection has not been shown to play a pathogenic role, further evidence that the condition is not a pyoderma, but rather a severe variant of rosacea 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>. Rosacea fulminans has also been referred to as granulomatous rosacea.

【25】44.2 Background
---------------

【26】The pathophysiology of rosacea fulminans is unknown. Hyperactivity of the innate immune system, severe emotional stress, hormonal changes (including those during pregnancy), and an association with inflammatory bowel disease have all been suggested 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 , 4 – 7 \]</u>. Helicobacter pylori bacteria have been identified in the gastric mucosa of patients with both rosacea and rosacea fulminans and is thought to stimulate production of vasoactive molecules, including prostaglandins, histamine, and various cytokines 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 8 , 9 \]</u>. A more in-depth review of the pathophysiology may be found in the rosacea chapter of this book.

【27】While extremely rare, rosacea fulminans is also assumed to be highly under-reported. Approximately 80 cases have been published since the 1940s. It occurs almost exclusively in healthy females in the second to third decades, but ages range from the teens into the 50s 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 , 2 \]</u>. There is no associated history with acne vulgaris 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>, but many patients may have an underlying diagnosis of rosacea 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 10 , 11 \]</u>.

【28】44.3 Clinical Presentation
--------------------------

【29】Rosacea fulminans is characterized by a sudden and explosive onset of large indurated erythematous plaques, nodules, papules, pustules, and draining sinuses restricted to the face . Patients generally has previously unblemished skin 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 , 2 , 11 \]</u>. The most severely affected areas of the face include the forehead, nasal bridge, cheeks, and chin 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>. Comedones are characteristically absent and the trunk is spared. Large abscesses may be interconnected through sinus tracts that discharge copious amounts of pus 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 \]</u>.

通用删除16(英):<u>Fig. 44.1|删除2图换行|An indurated, erythematous plaque on the left cheek of a woman in her 30s. Pustules and papules are evident within the plaque, and the patient complains of tenderness in the area (Photo credit: Joshua A. Zeichner, M.D.</u>

【31】No true prodrome exists prior to the onset of the disease. However, there are reports of patients who develop a sudden onset of excessive skin oiliness prior to the eruption 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 , 2 \]</u>. Patients are otherwise healthy, though some experience fatigue, discomfort, or general malaise. One patient has been reported to develop rosacea fulminans in association with erythema nodosum 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 12 \]</u>. Another report documented a case of severe ocular involvement presenting with blurry vision. Ophthalmologic exam revealed severe blepharitis with advanced keratitis and ocular perforation. While ocular involvement is common in traditional rosacea, it is not usually present in rosacea fulminans 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 11 \]</u>.

【32】Because of the particularly ferocious nature of the disease, patients may become depressed, anxious, and isolated because of the appearance 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 , 13 \]</u>. Scarring is common and expected and can range from minimal damage to keloids 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 , 14 \]</u>.

【33】44.4 Work-up
------------

【34】The diagnosis of rosacea fulminans is largely clinical, although supportive labs and a skin biopsy can be performed. Some patients have been documented to have a mild anemia, leukocytosis, increased erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR), elevated C-reactive protein (CRP), and positive rheumatoid factor and antinuclear antibodies 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 , 2 , 4 , 14 , 15 \]</u>. Skin biopsy reveals evidence of inflammation, with massive neutrophil infiltration in early stages and epithelioid cell granulomas in older lesions 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 4 , 12 , 16 \]</u>. Bacterial pathogens have not been consistently recovered, and most bacteria identified are commensal skin flora 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 , 3 \]</u>. Isolated cases report identification of Staphylococcus aureus and gram-negative bacteria 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 , 5 \]</u>.

【35】44.5 Treatment
--------------

【36】If untreated, rosacea fulminans generally resolves after approximately 1 year, although aggressive therapy is usually given to avoid the development of permanent scars. The most commonly effective treatment for rosacea fulminans is oral isotretinoin, usually in combination with oral corticosteroids to reduce the risk of an initial flare. Isotretinoin is typically dosed at 0.5 mg/kg/day for the first month then increased to 1 mg/kg/day at month 2, depending on the clinical appearance. Just as in acne vulgaris, the target cumulative dose is 120–150 mg/kg 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 , 4 , 11 , 17 – 19 \]</u>. Oral dapsone, oral and topical antibiotics, benzoyl peroxide, and topical and systemic corticosteroids, among others, have all been reported as well 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 , 5 , 6 , 18 , 20 \]</u>. Oral azithromycin has also been shown to be effective in a pregnant woman 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 15 \]</u>.

【37】Surgical interventions have been associated with poor outcomes. Incision and drainage of abscesses and sinus should not be performed as it can lead to excessive scarring 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 \]</u>. Early biopsy, however, can help correctly diagnose a patient early in the course of the disease and ultimately results in a more rapid treatment 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 16 \]</u>.

【38】44.6 Conclusion
---------------

【39】Rosacea fulminans is a rapidly occurring, severe facial dermatosis thought to be an extreme variant of rosacea. It results in significant scarring, both physically and emotionally. Early diagnosis with prompt treatment (usually with oral isotretinoin) is important to minimize long-term sequelae.

【72】Abstract

【73】Sarcoidosis is a multiorgan noninfectious granulomatous disease which can manifest in the integumentary system in a variety of ways, one of the most common being a maculopapular, acneiform facial eruption. Although sarcoidosis is generally categorized as a pulmonary disease, it involves the skin in approximately 25–30 % of cases. The etiology of sarcoidosis remains unknown. The polymorphic cutaneous lesions are grouped into specific and nonspecific lesions. The characteristic histological finding in sarcoidosis, the noncaseating granuloma, is present in the specific lesions of cutaneous sarcoidosis, including macules, papules, plaques, subcutaneous nodules, infiltrative scars, and lupus pernio. The nonspecific lesions of cutaneous sarcoidosis, such as erythema nodosum (EN), calcifications, erythema multiforme, and clubbing, lack this feature. Sarcoidosis is a diagnosis of exclusion based on a combination of clinical, histological, and radiographic evidence. Since cutaneous sarcoidosis is frequently present at the onset of systemic disease, the dermatologist is often the first health-care provider to evaluate the patient. Biopsy-proven cutaneous sarcoidosis warrants a further workup for systemic disease. Corticosteroids are the mainstay of treatment for symptomatic sarcoidosis, followed by antimalarial and immunosuppressive medications.

【76】45.2 Background
---------------

【77】There are many theories surrounding the etiology of sarcoidosis, but the cause(s) of the disease is still unknown. A multicenter trial of over 700 patients, entitled “A Case Control Etiologic Study of Sarcoidosis (ACCESS),” was unable to identify a specific antigen in sarcoidosis but did establish an increased risk of the disease with exposure to mold and musty odors, agricultural chemicals and aerosols, and insecticides 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 \]</u>. In sarcoidosis, normal tissue function is disrupted by noncaseating granulomas. The formation of the noncaseating granuloma begins with macrophages and dendritic cells (antigen-presenting cells) using class II major histocompatibility (MHC) complexes to present an unknown antigen(s) to CD4+ T cells 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 \]</u>. Through interactions with the MHC and costimulatory molecules, the T cell becomes activated and ignites a T H 1 inflammatory response. The T cells release IL-2 and IFN-γ to recruit additional T cells, as well as stimulate macrophages to produce TNF-α, leading to the differentiation of macrophages into epithelioid cells and formation of multinucleated giant cells 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 \]</u>.

【78】In the United States, there are two peaks for sarcoidosis, in people between 25 and 35 years and in women between 45 and 65 years 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>. Sarcoidosis is more common in African Americans (although all races can be affected), and this group is more likely to present with advanced disease and have a poorer prognosis 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 4 \]</u>. The highest incidence of disease in the United States in African American women in their fourth decade of life 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>. Sarcoidosis persists as a progressive disease in 30 % but has a mortality of less than 5 % 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 5 \]</u>. The most common causes of death are progressive pulmonary fibrosis or other pulmonary or cardiac complications 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 4 \]</u>. The first-degree relatives of people with sarcoidosis are at a 5-time increased risk for developing the disease 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 6 \]</u>. Recent research has proposed certain genetic susceptibilities associated with the disease. An increased risk of sarcoidosis is associated with HLA-DRB1 and a splice site mutation in the gene butyrophilin-like 2 (BTNL2) 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 7 \]</u>.

【118】页码间删除-1:<u>**INTRODUCTION**</u>

【119】**Peripheral T-cell lymphoma (PTCL)， not other wise specified， is a heterogeneous group of tumors with variable clinical fea-tures， histology， genetic alteration， response to treatment， and prognosis. It is a mature T-cell lymphoma that does not fulfill morphologic， phenotypic，1C， oOrr genetic criteria for any distinc- tive mature T-cell lymphoma category， hence the designation“not otherwise specified”通用删除6(英):<u>\[1-19\]</u>.**

【120】The distinction from other (specific) peripheral T-cell disorders is based on clinical， morphologic， phenotypic， and genetic data， but is not always clear， especially at the time of initial diagnosis. The main entities from which PTCL has to be differentiated include nodal involvement by T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia (T-PLL)， lymphomatous variant of adult T-cell lymphoma/leukemia (ATLL)， anaplastic large cell lymphoma (ALCL)， angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma (AITL)， and reactive T-cell infiltrates in b

【3】**Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells is less common than T-LGL leukemia and is characterized by a persistent (>6 months) increase in NK cells in the blood(<2×10/L) and chronic， nonprogressive clinical course. It is difficult to distinguish between reactive and neoplastic conditions. A transient increase in circulating NK cells may be seen in many conditions such as autoimmune disorders or viral infections.**

【4】Patients with chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells are most often asymptomatic but may have a gradual increase in circulating large granular lymphocytes(LGLs). 【119】**Peripheral T-cell lymphoma (PTCL)， not other wise specified， is a heterogeneous group of tumors with variable clinical fea-tures， histology， genetic alteration， response to treatment， and prognosis. It is a mature T-cell lymphoma that does not fulfill morphologic， phenotypic，1C， oOrr genetic criteria for any distinc- tive mature T-cell lymphoma category， hence the designation“not otherwise specified”通用删除6(英):<u>\[1-19\]</u>.**

【120】The distinction from other (specific) peripheral T-cell disorders is based on clinical， morphologic， phenotypic， and genetic data， but is not always clear， especially at the time of initial diagnosis. The main entities from which PTCL has to be differentiated include nodal involvement by T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia (T-PLL)， lymphomatous variant of adult T-cell lymphoma/leukemia (ATLL)， anaplastic large cell lymphoma (ALCL)， angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma (AITL)， and reactive T-cell infiltrates in b

Low-grade surface osteosarcoma is usually termed parosteal osteosarcoma. The lesion arises on the outside surface of the bone， virtually never pro-voking a periosteal reaction (361，418，431). Histologi-cally， the proliferating portion of the neoplasm consists of a fibrous stroma， considered to be derived from the outer fibrous periosteal laver. Dedifferentiated parosteal osteosarcoma is a high-grade variant of the former tu-mor (393，455). Periosteal osteosarcoma belongs to an intermediate grade of surface lesions (434). This lesion may cause periosteal response and usually consists mostly of cartilage (381). The lesion is believed to be de-rived from the inner， or cambium， layer of periosteum. High-grade surface osteosarcoma is a lesion located on the periphery of a bone. It has a histology identical to that of conventional medullary osteosarcoma and a simi-lar metastatic potential (363，454，460).

【5】**_Parosteal Osteosarcoma_**

【6】This type of surface osteosarcoma， which accounts for about 4% of all osteosarcomas， is seen in patients in their third and fourth decades， and characteristically affects the posterior aspect of the distal femur (414). Other locations include the tibia， the fibula， and the proximal portions of the femur and humerus(331). Rarely are other bones affected (306，312). Be-cause the tumor is slow growing and usually involves only the surface of the bone， the prognosis is much better than for the other types of osteosarcoma.

【7】On radiologic studies， the neoplasm presents as a dense oval or spherical mass attached to the surface of the cortical bone . The surface is lobulated and may be less dense than the base of the tumor . The mass appears sharply delineated from the peripheral soft tissues. The medullary cavity is usually spared unless the lesion is of long duration. A linear， translucent cleft usually forms an incomplete separa-tion of the bulk of the tumor from the underlying cortex . Larger lesions， however， tend to en-circle the host bone (361). Although these features can be adequately demonstrated by conventional radiogra-phy， CT  or MRI  is often neces-sary to determine the extent of cortical penetration and intramedullary invasion by tumor (295).

【8】The histology of this tumor is characterized by a high degree of structural differentiation and consists of im-mature (woven) bone in different stages of maturation to lamellar bone (395). The lamellar trabeculae， which predominate in most areas， are separated by a bland， well-differentiated fibrous stroma composed of spindle cells. The cytoplasm contains conspicuous rough endoplasmic reticulum， lakes of glycogen， and lipid vacuoles. The cytoplasmic membrane displays scanty， thin projections. The cells are surrounded by an abundant intercellular matrix of low electron density， with thin fibrils and granules (336). The prognosis for periosteal osteosarcoma is somewhat better than for conventional osteosarcoma but worse than for parosteal osteosarcoma(395).

【33】Only few genetic studies have been reported with complex chromosomal aberrations in four cases and a numerical gain of chromosome 17 in one case (229).

【34】**_High-Grade Surface Osteosarcoma_**

A small percentage of surface osteosarcomas are high-grade tumors and they carry the same prognosis as con-ventional osteosarcoma. The less common of these le-sions， high-grade surface osteosarcoma， accounting for less than 1% of all osteosarcomas in a Mayo Clinic study(455)， exhibits radiologic features similar to those of parosteal or periosteal osteosarcoma (289) . Men are affected more frequently than women (M/F =1.6：1). The most frequent site for this tumor is the femur(46%)，followed by the humerus (16%) (363). It is histo-logically indistinct from conventional osteosarcoma  and， like the latter， it has a high potential for dis-tant metastases (455). Although intramedullary exten-|删除0换行|sion of the tumor is uncommon， the cortex may be in-volved and pathologic fractures may occur.

【36】**D. Soft Tissue (Extraskeletal) Osteosarcomas**

【37】Osteosarcoma of the soft tissues (extraskeletal， ex-traosseous) is an uncommon malignant tumor of mes-enchymal origin， with the capacity to form neoplastic osteoid， bone， and cartilage (217，327，384). Middle-aged and elderly individuals are most often affected， with a mean age at presentation of 54 years (238，412)， although at times this tumor may present in a younger individual (408). Extraskeletal osteosarcoma is consid-erably less common than osteosarcoma of bone， ac-counting for only 4% of all osteosarcomas (206). The preferential sites for this neoplasm are in the lower ex-tremities and buttocks (262，278，319，382，403，459). Al-though most of these tumors are of a high-grade malig nancy， few cases of a low-grade lesion have been reported (362). The lesion may also develop in a vari-ety of soft tissues such as breast， lung， thyroid， renal capsule， urinary bladder， and prostate， and even within the mesentery and pelvic retroperitoneum (237). Occa-sionally， a soft tissue osteosarcoma arises after radiation therapy. Exceptionally it may arise in myositis ossificans(317).

【38】The most common clinical presentation is that of a slowly enlarging mass， with or without pain. The radi-ographic hallmarks include a soft tissue mass with scat-tered， amorphous calcifications and ossifications. The mass exhibits a disorganized arrangement of osteogenic elements in the center of the tumor . If the mass develops in close proximity to bone， it may invade the cortex.

【1】Gynecologic causes of pelvic floor muscle pain are most _0_ often produced by inflammatory processes (including infec-tion)， neoplasia， or trauma. In addition， pelvic girdle pain may be associated with pregnancy and endometriosis. Varia-tions in the angle and position of the uterus occur from woman to woman and from day to day in the same woman. Uterine position rarely causes pain.

【2】Children younger than 14 years rarely experience pelvic pain of gynecologic origin. Infection is the most likely cause and is limited to the vulva and vagina. Theoretically， infection can ascend to involve the peritoneal cavity， causing iliopsoas abscess and pelvic， hip， or groin pain， but this rarely happens in this age group.

【3】**Ectopic Pregnancy**

【4】Pelvic pain associated with normal pregnancy is similar to low back pain， as was discussed earlier in Chapter 14. About1% of all pregnancies take place outside of the endometrium iS OCC(ectopic)， with most ectopic implantations occurring in the fallopian tube . Risk factors include tubal ligation； STD； pelvic inflammatory disease； infertility or infertility treatment； previous tubal， pelvic， or abdominal surgery； or the use of intrauterine contraceptive devices (IUCDs) such as rings， loops， coils， or T-shaped devices .

【5】Symptoms of ectopic pregnancy most often include unex-plained vaginal spotting， bursts of bleeding， and sudden lower abdominal and pelvic cramping shortly after the first missed menstrual period. At first， the pain may be a vague“twinge"or soreness on the affected side； later it can be sharp and severe.

【14】Prolapse is the collapse， falling down， or downward dis-placement of structures such as the uterus， bladder， or rec-tum. This condition occasionally causes low back pain， often causes perineal pressure but rarely causes pain.

【15】Uterovaginal prolapse may rarely cause low-grade and persistent pelvic pain. Prolapse may result from a combina-tion of the effects of pregnancy and delivery， postmenopausal hormone changes， surgical cutting of pelvic ligaments (i.e.， during hysterectomy)，and poor pelvic floor muscle support.

【27】Similar to the prolapsed uterus， these two pelvic floor dis-orders occur most often after pregnancy and childbirth but may also be associated with surgery and obesity (especially obesity combined with multiple pregnancies and births). These conditions are the result of pelvic floor muscle weak-ness or structural overstretching of the pelvic musculature or ligamentous structures. 【30】**Endometriosis**

【31】Endometriosis  is a pathologic condition of retrograde menstruation. Tissue resembling the mucous membrane lining the uterus occurs outside the normal loca-tion in the uterus but within the pelvic cavity， including the ovaries， pelvic peritoneum， bowel， and diaphragm.
