【34】**CLOZAPINE**

【35】**Clozapine is unique in its clinical effectiveness and side effect profile； clinical applications and side effects， and its use in treatment will be covered in this review. For the other atypicals， a broad discussion of side effects is covered in chapter 13.**

【36】Clinical Implications of the Use of Clozapine

【37】Clozapine is considered the most effective atypical antipsychotic available. It has a broad-spectrum therapeutic action and is considered superior to the other SGAs in therapeutic effectiveness. The side effect risks are potentially very seri-ous and for that reason clozapine is not a first line medication. It is reserved for refractory cases. Clozapine is an option for severe psychotic and mood disorders， which have not responded to other second generation medications.

【38】Clozapine should also be considered in cases of protracted suicidality and in patients with persistent aggressiveness and impulsivity， when these dimen-sions of psychopathology have not responded to alternative treatments. So far， clozapine is only FDA approved for resistant schizophrenia in adults. See endnote for information regarding clozapine receptor affinity and cytochrome activity.

【39】In December 2005， Novartis announced some changes related to param-eters of clozapine monitoring. During the first six months， WBC and ANC will be monitored weekly； after six months， tolerance permitting， blood monitoring will be biweekly. After one year， other things being equal， blood monitoring may be done monthly. For patients who are rechallenged on clozapine， weekly blood monitoring for the first 12 months is recommended 删除2:<u>(Bess & Cunning-ham， 2005，p. 1)</u>.

【40】_Clinical Applications_

【41】Clozapine has demonstrated superior effectiveness on positive and negative symptoms and is still the golden standard against which all the other atypical an-tipsychotics medications are measured. Clozapine has been demonstrated to be：

【42】1\. Effective in at least some patients for whom the typical neuroleptics have failed；

【43】参考段删除-1:<u>2\. Preferentially effective with so-called negative symptoms (apathy， amotiva-tion， etc.)；</u>

【44】参考段删除-1:<u>3\. Beneficial for symptoms related to mood and cognition 删除2:<u>(Kapur & Rem-ington，2001， p.504)</u>.</u>

【45】Clozapine appears to have a decisive advantage in decreasing aggression in comparison to the other atypicals 删除2:<u>(Citrome， Bilder， & Volavka， 2002，p.210)</u>. Clozapine may be of particular benefit to patients with treatment refractory schizophrenic spectrum illness who demonstrate hostile and aggressive be-haviors 删除2:<u>(Marder & Wirshing， 2004， p. 446)</u>. Clozapine shows superiority over olanzapine and risperidone in the reduction of levels of hostility； this effect is independent of its antipsychotic activity and is also independent of clozapine’s sedative effect 删除2:<u>(Citrome， Bilder， & Volavka， 2002， p. 210)</u>.

【46】Clozapine also may be the preferred agent for patients with schizophrenia who are at a higher risk of suicide. Large epidemiological studies have found that mortality from suicide is reduced in patients taking clozapine 删除2:<u>(Marder &Wirshing， 2004， p. 446)</u>. The most convincing study demonstrating antisuicidal benefits in adults was based on a comparison of clozapine and olanzapine in980 patients with schizophrenia， considered at risk for suicide. In that study， clozapine was more effective in reducing suicidal risk than olanzapine 删除1:<u>(Melt-zer， 2002)</u>. Unfortunately， the lives saved by clozapine's antisuicidal activity may essentially be offset by the deaths associated with weight gain and its complications 删除2:<u>(Marder & Wirshing， 2004， pp.451-452)</u>. Patients should not be considered treatment refractory or partial responders until they have had an adequate trial of clozapine . Clozapine may also have advantages for patients with polydipsia-hyponatremia syndrome . Clozapine also reduces impulsivity 删除2:<u>(Meltzer， 2002， p.281)</u>.

【47】The acid test of therapeutic superiority of atypical antipsychotics over conventional antipsychotics is their impact on chronic resistant schizophrenia. The effectiveness of second generation antipsychotics (risperidone， olanzapine， and newer atypicals)， other than clozapine， in the reduction of symptoms in treatment resistant schizophrenia has not been established 删除2:<u>(Chakos， Lieberman， Hoffman， Bradford， & Sheitman， 2001，p. 523)</u>. Patients who are more severely symptomatic at baseline are the most likely to benefit from clozapine treat-ment . The CATIE II report substantiated the therapeutic superiority of clozapine over other second generation antipsychotics， mainly， olanzapine， risperidone and quetiapine 删除1:<u>(McEvoy， Lieberman， Stroup， et al.，2006)</u>.

【48】Clozapine might be more effective than other antipsychotics because of its additional effects， which include mood stabilization， and catatonia prophy-lactic effects， similar to lithium. Its mood-stabilizing effects differ from the decrease in mania severity produced by antipsychotics. Clozapine also shows narcotic analgesia effects that are blocked by naloxone 删除2:<u>(Swartz， 2003，p.13)</u>. Accumulating evidence suggests that clozapine is particularly effective for manic symptoms that are nor responsive to other agents 删除2:<u>(Marder & Wirshing，2004， p.447)</u>. Clozapine has a very low risk of TD； actually， this medication has antidyskinetic activity. In clinical practice， the more the dyskinetic symp-tomatology， the better the antipsychotic results.

【49】参考段删除-1:<u>Reports suggest that Clozapine decreases the frequency ofsmoking among schizophrenic patients 删除2:<u>(Procyshyn， Ihsan， & Thompson， 2001， pp.292-293)</u> and that it may also be effective for adult patients with borderline personality disorder 删除2:<u>(Parker， 2002， pp. 348-349； Swinton， 2001， pp. 580-591)</u>.</u>

【50】Blood levels are correlated with therapeutic effectiveness； levels around 450mcg/ml are considered therapeutic. Plasma level studies show that patients with higher clozapine plasma levels had an excellent response， whereas those with lower levels had a poor response 删除2:<u>(Davis， Chen， & Glick， 2003， p.556)</u>. A typi-cal daily dose of 300 to 400 mg/day (about 5 mg/kg) is associated with plasma levels ranging from 200 to 400 mg/ml 删除2:<u>(Marder & Wirshing， 2004，p. 445)</u>.

【36】**The differential diagnosis includes SMZL， MCL， FL， LPL/WM， and SDRPL.**

【37】**LYMPHOPLASMACYTIC LYMPHOMA/WALDENSTROM MACROGLOBULINEMIA**

【38】LPL/WM shows involvement of the white and red pulps by mixture of small lymphocytes， lymphoplasmacytic cells， and plasma cells. Dutcher bodies are present and may be promi-nent. White pulp is expanded and diffusely infiltrate by neo-plastic cells without a biphasic pattern. The residual follicles may be present， but are usually atrophic without germinal centers； they can be visualized by immunostaining with CD21 and CD23. Red pulp is diffusely involved by lympho-plasmacytic infiltrate with a preserved architecture and with-out involvement of the sinuses. Histiocytes and mast cells may be increased， the former with hemosiderin pigment. Lymphomatous cells have nonspecific phenotype (they are negative for CD5， CD10， BCL6， annexin-A1， and CD103).

【39】**DIFFERENTIAL DIAGNOSIS**

The differential diagnosis includes other low-grade B-cell lymphoproliferations， especially with prominent plasmacytic differentiation. B-CLL/SLL can be distinguished by the presence of proliferation centers (clusters of prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts) and specific phenotype (CD5/CD23coexpression). MCLs are positive for CD5 and BCLl (cyclin D1). SMZL shows often a biphasic pattern， follicle coloniza-tion， and a monocytic appearance of B cells-features not seen in LPL/WM. FL is distinguished by cytology (cen-trocytes and centroblasts) and coexpression of CD10 and BCL6. Splenic FLs are positive for BCL2 rearrangement|删除0换行|by fluorescence in situ hybridization \[FISH； or polymerase chain reaction (PCR) testing.

【41】**MANTLE CELL LYMPHOMA**

【42】MCL  involving the spleen shows usu-ally the involvement of the white pulp， but prominent diffuse involvement with massive splenomegaly and leukemic blood involvement with “prolymphocytoid"morphology have been reported 通用删除6(英):<u>\[1，63\]</u>. Typical MCL shows a prominent mantle zone surrounding a reactive germinal center， which may be well preserved or atrophic due to colonizing mantle cells. Cases with somewhat a biphasic pattern mimicking SMZL， a nodu-lar pattern mimicking FL， and aggressive variants (blastoid or pleomorphic) can also occur. Immunophenotypic analysis shows expression of B-cell markers， CD5， SOX11， and BCL1(cyclin D1). Some cases of MCL may be CD5-or CD10+ .

【0】ti-CD22 immunotoxin is highly effective. It shares more similarities with SMZL (splenic lymphoma with villous lymphocytes) and SDRPL than with HCL 通用删除6(英):<u>\[52\]</u>. HCL-V differs from typical HCL by worse prognosis and poor response to interferon alpha and purine analogs， cladribine or pentostatin. New agents， such as rituximab and BL22 (anti-CD22 immunotoxin)， are actively being evalu-ated and show promising results in both classical HCL and CD25-variant.**

【1】页码间删除-1:<u>**MORPHOLOGY**</u>

【2】页码间删除-1:<u>**Blood and BM Aspirate**</u>

【3】Cytologically， the leukemic cells are characterized by an abundant basophilic cytoplasm with villous projections， regular nuclear borders， and prominent nucleolus (features intermediate between hairy cells or prolymphocytes).

【4】页码间删除-1:<u>**BM Core Biopsy**</u>

【5】**The pattern of BM involvement is more reminiscent of SMZL with mild infiltrate (predominantly intrasinusoidal) and a good hematopoietic reserve 通用删除6(英):<u>\[12\]</u>. Some cases show a mixture of intrasinusoidal and interstitial patterns and rarely a nodular pattern or a prominent diffuse infiltrate. Paratrabecular marrow involvement is not reported in HCL-V.**

【6】页码间删除-1:<u>**Spleen**</u>

【7】**In the spleen， the infiltrate involves the red pulp with morphologic features overlapping with SDRPL and HCL.**

【8】页码间删除-1:<u>**Immunophenotype**</u>

【9】The immunophenotype shows a mature B-cell phenotype with expression of B-cell antigens， CDlle， and CD103， but unlike typical HCL， the cells are negative for CD25 and annexin-1 删除2:<u>(some cases may show faint CD25 expression， but never bright as seen in HCL)</u>. The CD123 may be positive in HCL-V (usually dim)， but majority of cases are negative. The expression of CD20， CD22， and surface immunoglobulin light chains (by flow cytometry) is bright. CD11c is usually bright (SMZL shows dim CD1lc expression in subset of cases and SDRPL most often has moderate CD1lc). Annexin-1is positive only in HCL (SMZL， SDRPL， and HCL-V are negative).

【11】**The differential diagnosis includes SMZL， SDRPL， HCL， and other low-grade B-cell lymphomas. The chromosomal abnormalities described in SDRPL are those recurrently described in SMZL \[del(7q)， partial trisomy 3q， and com-plete trisomy 18\] 通用删除6(英):<u>\[12\]</u>. HCL and HCL-V rarely show abnor-mal karyotype \[e.g.， del(17p)， +12\]， whereas SMZL has abnormal karyotype in 80% \[+3， +18， de(17q)\] and SDRPL in ~30% of cases \[+3， del(7q)\]. It is suggested that SMZL，**

【12】HCL-V， and SDRPL may represent the overlapping enti-ties. HCL shows bright CD20， CD22， CD11c， and CD123expression， and is always positive for CD25. Also an aber-rant expression of CD10 is seen more often in HCL than in HCL-V. In contrast to HCL， HCL-V is negative for BRAF V600E mutations 通用删除6(英):<u>\[53-56\]</u>. SMZL are negative for CD103and CD123 by flow cytometry， although dim CD123 may be occasionally seen on subset of cells.

Clinical findings (sple-nomegaly， lymphocytosis without pancytopenia) are remi-niscent of HCL-V 通用删除6(英):<u>\[57\]</u>. Men are affected more often than women and patients are usually in advanced age. The most frequent chromosomal changes include chromosome 7q deletion， complete trisomy 18， and partial trisomy 3q 通用删除6(英):<u>\[57\]</u>. This is an indolent butincurable disease with good response after splenectomy.**

【16】页码间删除-1:<u>**Blood**</u>

【18】页码间删除-1:<u>**Spleen**</u>

**BM aspirate shows small lymphocytes with villous pro-cesses 删除2:<u>(similar to those seen in blood smear)</u>. BM core biopsy infiltrate is often subtle on hematoxylin and eosin(H&E) sections. 【0】ti-CD22 immunotoxin is highly effective. It shares more similarities with SMZL (splenic lymphoma with villous lymphocytes) and SDRPL than with HCL 通用删除6(英):<u>\[52\]</u>. HCL-V differs from typical HCL by worse prognosis and poor response to interferon alpha and purine analogs， cladribine or pentostatin. New agents， such as rituximab and BL22 (anti-CD22 immunotoxin)， are actively being evalu-ated and show promising results in both classical HCL and CD25-variant.**

<mark>【1】页码间删除-1:MORPHOLOGY

【2】页码间删除-1:Blood and BM Aspirate</mark> and BM Aspirate**</u>

【3】Cytologically， the leukemic cells are characterized by an abundant basophilic cytoplasm with villous projections， regular nuclear borders， and prominent nucleolus (features intermediate between hairy cells or prolymphocytes).

【4】页码间删除-1:<u>**BM Core Biopsy**</u>

【5】**The pattern of BM involvement is more reminiscent of SMZL with mild infiltrate (predominantly intrasinusoidal) and a good hematopoietic reserve 通用删除6(英):<u>\[12\]</u>. Some cases show a mixture of intrasinusoidal and interstitial patterns and rarely a nodular pattern or a prominent diffuse infiltrate. Paratrabecular marrow involvement is not reported in HCL-V.**

【6】页码间删除-1:<u>**Spleen**</u>

【7】**In the spleen， the infiltrate involves the red pulp with morphologic features overlapping with SDRPL and HCL.**

【8】页码间删除-1:<u>**Immunophenotype**</u>

【9】The immunophenotype shows a mature B-cell phenotype with expression of B-cell antigens， CDlle， and CD103， but unlike typical HCL， the cells are negative for CD25 and annexin-1 删除2:<u>(some cases may show faint CD25 expression， but never bright as seen in HCL)</u>. The CD123 may be positive in HCL-V (usually dim)， but majority of cases are negative. The expression of CD20， CD22， and surface immunoglobulin light chains (by flow cytometry) is bright. CD11c is usually bright (SMZL shows dim CD1lc expression in subset of cases and SDRPL most often has moderate CD1lc). Annexin-1is positive only in HCL (SMZL， SDRPL， and HCL-V are negative).

【10】页码间删除-1:<u>**Differential Diagnosis**</u>

【11】**The differential diagnosis includes SMZL， SDRPL， HCL， and other low-grade B-cell lymphomas. The chromosomal abnormalities described in SDRPL are those recurrently described in SMZL \[del(7q)， partial trisomy 3q， and com-plete trisomy 18\] 通用删除6(英):<u>\[12\]</u>. HCL and HCL-V rarely show abnor-mal karyotype \[e.g.， del(17p)， +12\]， whereas SMZL has abnormal karyotype in 80% \[+3， +18， de(17q)\] and SDRPL in ~30% of cases \[+3， del(7q)\]. It is suggested that SMZL，**

【12】HCL-V， and SDRPL may represent the overlapping enti-ties. HCL shows bright CD20， CD22， CD11c， and CD123expression， and is always positive for CD25. Also an aber-rant expression of CD10 is seen more often in HCL than in HCL-V. In contrast to HCL， HCL-V is negative for BRAF V600E mutations 通用删除6(英):<u>\[53-56\]</u>. SMZL are negative for CD103and CD123 by flow cytometry， although dim CD123 may be occasionally seen on subset of cells.

【13】页码间删除-1:<u>**SPLENIC DIFFUSE RED PULP SMALL B-CELL LYMPHOMA**</u>

【14】**SDRPL is an uncommon lymphoma with a diffuse pat-tern of involvement of the splenic red pulp， BM sinusoids， and peripheral blood by small monomorphous basophilic B lymphocytes often with villous cytoplasm 通用删除6(英):<u>\[1，15，21，57，58\]</u>. All cases are diagnosed at clinical stage IV with spleen， BM， and blood involvement 通用删除6(英):<u>\[15\]</u>. Rare cases with skin involvement have been reported. Clinical findings (sple-nomegaly， lymphocytosis without pancytopenia) are remi-niscent of HCL-V 通用删除6(英):<u>\[57\]</u>. Men are affected more often than women and patients are usually in advanced age. The most frequent chromosomal changes include chromosome 7q deletion， complete trisomy 18， and partial trisomy 3q 通用删除6(英):<u>\[57\]</u>. This is an indolent butincurable disease with good response after splenectomy.**

【15】页码间删除-1:<u>**MORPHOLOGY**</u>

【16】页码间删除-1:<u>**Blood**</u>

【17】**Peripheral blood smear shows a homogeneous infiltrate of small- to medium-sized cells with round or oval nuclei. sometimes eccentrically placed， and dense and clumped chromatin， basophilicCwith characteristic broad-based， unevenly distributedcytoplasmicexpansions(villous projections) 通用删除6(英):<u>\[15\]</u>.**

【18】页码间删除-1:<u>**Spleen**</u>

【19】**The spleen shows diffuse involvement of the red pulp， with both cord and sinusoid infiltration and characteristic intra-sinusoidal aggregates (pattern similar to HCL and HCL-V). White pulp is most often also replaced or atrophic and shows only occasional follicles. Some lymphoplasmacytoid cells can be observed on blood smear or in the spleen.**

【20】页码间删除-1:<u>**Bone Marrow**</u>

**BM aspirate shows small lymphocytes with villous pro-cesses 删除2:<u>(similar to those seen in blood smear)</u>. BM core biopsy infiltrate is often subtle on hematoxylin and eosin(H&E) sections. It shows characteristic intrasinusoidal involvement， which occasionally can be accompanied by interstitial or nodular infiltration. In a series of SDRPL reported by Ponzoni et al. 通用删除6(英):<u>\[32\]</u>， pure intrasinusoidal， pure interstitial， diffuse， mixed1intrasinusoidal-interstitial， and nodular combined with other types were observed in|删除0换行|13%，11%， 11%，37%， and 28% of cases， respectively 通用删除6(英):<u>\[32\]</u>. No paratrabecular has been reported. Reticulin fibrosis is minimal. Presence of a significant percentage of medium-to large-sized cells with a prominent nucleolus suggests progression (transformation).**

【22】**IMMUNOPHENOTYPE**

【23】**Flow Cytometry**

【24】**Neoplastic B cells are positive for CD20 (strong expression)， CD22 (strong expression)， and CD1lc (subset of cases； mod-erate expression)， and are negative for CD10， CD25， CD103， and CD123 通用删除6(英):<u>\[1，12，15，21，59\]</u>. Occasional cases may show partial and dim expression of CD103 通用删除6(英):<u>\[60\]</u>. Flow cytometric analysis shows an occasional expression of CD5 or CD23(without coexpression)通用删除6(英):<u>\[15\]</u>.**

【25】**Immunohistochemistrv**

【26】**Lymphoma cells in SDRPL express B-cell markers (CD19， CD20， CD22， CD79a， PAX5)， BCL2， and DBA44， and are negative for CD5， CD10， CD23， CD43， BCL1 (cyclin D1)， BCL6，MUM1，and annexin-A1通用删除6(英):<u>\[15，32，58\]</u>.**

【28】The differential diagnosis includes SMZL， HCL， LPL， and HCL-V. The comparison between SDRPL and SMZL has been previously reported 通用删除6(英):<u>\[57\]</u>. The circulating cell morphol-ogy and the pattern of spleen involvement are clearly distinct. The villous expansions of SDRPL are distinct from the short and thin cytoplasmic expansions of the villoid cells usually observed in SMZL. The spleen histology is also distinct：SMZL shows follicular replacement， biphasic cytology， and marginal zone infiltration； neither marginal zone expansion nor biphasic features are observed in SDRPL. The immu-nophenotype by flow cytometry shows a different pattern of expression ofCD1lc and CD22 and an absence of expression of CD24， CD38， and CD27 通用删除6(英):<u>\[60\]</u>. The use of a scoring system based on the expression of CD11c， CD22， CD76， CD38，and CD27 appears to improve the differential diagnosis between SDRPL and SMZL. The statistically significant difference in progression-free survival with SMZL supports the view of SDRPL as a more indolent disease\[571.

**SDRPL shares with HCL some common features， such as the male predominance， the massive congested red pulp pat-tern with sometimes blood lakes， the rarity of clonal chro-mosomal abnormalities， and the expression of classical HCL markers (i.e.， CD11c， CD103， and CD123). The cytoplasmic expansions in SDRPL are shorter and larger with a less abundant and more baso-philic cytoplasm and a polar distribution around the cell contrasting with the circumferential distribution observed in hairy cells 通用删除6(英):<u>\[15\]</u>. The chromatin pattern， in the peripheral|删除0换行|blood and spleen， is quite distinct in most cases， and the cyto-plasm presents straight boundaries. The large blood lakes are not always present， and if present， are less prominent. The intensity of expression of CD11c， CD103， and CD123is much lower in SDRPL than in HCL. 【30】SDRPL and HCL-V have a very similar clinicopathological presentation and the differential diagnosis is not easy 通用删除6(英):<u>\[57，62\]</u>. However， the nucleolus described as small or not visible in SDRPL is prominent in HCL-V. The spleen section shows a monomorphic diffuse infiltrate， predominant in the conges-tive red pulp with atrophic white pulp 通用删除6(英):<u>\[15\]</u>. Small blood lakes can be observed. The BM infiltrate shows a variable cellularity and mild fibrosis with predominantly intrasinusoidal lymphoid infiltrate， which can be accompanied by interstitial or nodu-lar infiltration. The immunophenotype is distinct from SMZL and HCL with moderate expression of CD11c and CD22， low expression of CD103， but absence of CD25 and annexin-1expression 通用删除6(英):<u>\[15\]</u>.

【31】In the BM， LPL often shows paratrabecular involvement， a pattern not identified in SDRPL.

【32】**CHRONIC LYMPHOCYTIC LEUKEMIA**

【33】CLL/SLL， apart from the BM and blood， frequently involves the lymph nodes， spleen， and other extranodal sites. The white pulp is expanded with a prominent nodular pattern. Red pulp is also often involved with a diffuse and/or nodular pattern. The lymphoid cells are mostly small with a mature chromatic pattern and a scanty cytoplasm， but various proportions of

通用删除16(英):<u>**FIGURE 45.7 Spleen—B-SLL/CLL (inset： higher magnification shows prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblast； arrow).**</u>|删除换行|prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts are often identified. In most cases， there are no residual reactive germinal centers. Leukemic cells express CD19， CD20 (dim)， PAX5， CD5， CD23， and BCL2， and are negative for BCL1(cyclin Dl)， annexin-A1， BCL6，and CD10.**

【35】**DIFFERENTIAL DIAGNOSIS**

【36】**The differential diagnosis includes SMZL， MCL， FL， LPL/WM， and SDRPL.**

【37】**LYMPHOPLASMACYTIC LYMPHOMA/WALDENSTROM MACROGLOBULINEMIA**

【38】LPL/WM shows involvement of the white and red pulps by mixture of small lymphocytes， lymphoplasmacytic cells， and plasma cells. Dutcher bodies are present and may be promi-nent. White pulp is expanded and diffusely infiltrate by neo-plastic cells without a biphasic pattern. The residual follicles may be present， but are usually atrophic without germinal centers； they can be visualized by immunostaining with CD21 and CD23. Red pulp is diffusely involved by lympho-plasmacytic infiltrate with a preserved architecture and with-out involvement of the sinuses. Histiocytes and mast cells may be increased， the former with hemosiderin pigment. Lymphomatous cells have nonspecific phenotype (they are negative for CD5， CD10， BCL6， annexin-A1， and CD103).

【42】MCL  involving the spleen shows usu-ally the involvement of the white pulp， but prominent diffuse involvement with massive splenomegaly and leukemic blood involvement with “prolymphocytoid"morphology have been reported 通用删除6(英):<u>\[1，63\]</u>. 【43】**DIFFERENTIAL DIAGNOSIS**

SMZLs are only rarely CD5+；1they do not express BCL1 (cyclin D1) and are negative for t(11；14). Cases with predominance of intermediate- to large-sized cells (blastoid or pleomorphic variants) need to be|删除0换行|differentiated from DLBCL and T-cell lymphomas. Cases with homogeneous nodules composed of cells with irregular nuclei resembling FL. FL is distinguished by lack of CD5 and positive CD10 expression (FISH studies are positive for BCL2and negative for CCNDI rearrangement).

【45】**FOLLICULAR LYMPHOMA**

【46】FL frequently involves the spleen and shows phenotypic and cytogenetic findings similar to nodal FL 通用删除6(英):<u>\[18，19\]</u>. Splenic FL shows two patterns of involvement： pattern with an abnor-mal architecture due to prominent nodular infiltrate with scanty red pulp  and pattern with a mostly preserved architecture and scattered atypical follicles 通用删除6(英):<u>\[18\]</u>. A multimicronodular pattern is most common， especially in a secondary FL. The nodules are often rather homogeneous in size and shape， but some cases show heterogeneous fol-licles. Splenic FL may present with prominent splenomegaly with minimal or no lymphadenopathy 通用删除6(英):<u>\[19\]</u>. Lymphoid cells are mostly small to intermediate in size and have irregular nuclei (germinal center cytologic composition， mostly centrocytes and scattered centroblasts). Marginal zone-like cells may be present at the periphery of the nodules 通用删除6(英):<u>\[19\]</u>. Lymphomatous cells express B-cell mark-ers， CD10， BCL6， and BCL2. Rare cases with lack of either CD10 or BCL2 expression have been reported. The majority

【49】of splenic FLs show BCL2 rearrangement by FISH studies. Splenic FL cases showed frequent relapses， with an overall survival of 55% at 5 years 通用删除6(英):<u>\[19\]</u>.

【51】**The differential diagnosis includes reactive hyperplasia and other lymphomas， including SMZL and MCL. It is suggested that it repre-sents a distinet clinicopathological entity. The lymphoma cells proliferate diffusely and noncohesively in the cords of the red pulp . The lymphoma cells infiltrate the intrasinusoidal and intravascular spaces.

【57】**HAIRY CELL LEUKEMIA**

【58】HCL is described in detail in Chapter 14. The spleen shows atrophic white pulp and prominent red pulp infiltration with fill-ing of the cords and typical blood lakes consisting of hemorrhage surrounded by hairy cells 通用删除6(英):<u>\[1\]</u>. 【33】CLL/SLL， apart from the BM and blood， frequently involves the lymph nodes， spleen， and other extranodal sites. The white pulp is expanded with a prominent nodular pattern. 【38】LPL/WM shows involvement of the white and red pulps by mixture of small lymphocytes， lymphoplasmacytic cells， and plasma cells. Dutcher bodies are present and may be promi-nent. The differential diagnosis includes other low-grade B-cell lymphoproliferations， especially with prominent plasmacytic differentiation. 【53】DLBCL  is one of the most common lym-phoma types involving the spleen. It may represent a primary splenic lymphoma or a systemic disease. Some of the splenic DLBCLs occur in the setting of hepati-tis C viral infection. Any of the morphological variants typical for nodal DLBCL may develop in the spleen . The majority of cases present as large， rather well-demarcated masses composed of intermediate- to large-sized cells with centroblastic， immunoblastic， or mixed morphology. Other variants include intravascu-lar lymphoma， DLBCL with anaplastic features， T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma (THRLBCL)， and splenic large cell lymphoma involving the red pulp.

According to the WHO， this lymphoma is morphologically characterized by <10% of large neoplastic B cells in a back-ground of abundant T cells and frequently histiocytes 通用删除6(英):<u>\[21\]</u>.

The lymphoma cells infiltrate the intrasinusoidal and intravascular spaces.

This DLBCL variant is characterized by a high Ki-67 index (<90%)， commonly a nongerminal center/activated B-cell immunophenotype， and lack of Epstein-Barr virus and human herpes virus 6 and8 reactivity 通用删除6(英):<u>\[66\]</u>. 【1】Wart regression is probably the result of cell-mediated immune mechanisms, although the process is not completely understood 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 18 \]</u>. Considerations related to treatment of flat warts include the patient’s age, immune status, skin integrity, and potential cosmetic outcome. Despite the fact that a wide range of local treatments for nongenital cutaneous warts exists, there is only limited reliable evidence regarding the efficacy of various potential interventions 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 17 \]</u>. Viral wart survival is based on evading the immune detection apparatus within the epidermis. Inflammation of the skin may stimulate a concurrent immunologic response against HPV. Keratolytics, such as many over-the-counter products containing with salicylic acid or prescription strength retinoids, are frequently used for flat warts. These cause chemical irritation and debridement of the wart’s keratotic surface. In reality, topical salicylic acid products have the highest grade clinical evidence regarding their superiority to placebo 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 17 \]</u>. Topical retinoids are potent keratolytics but also assist in the treatment of warts by the disruption of epidermal growth and differentiation, as well as via modest immunomodulatory effects. One study investigating tretinoin 0.05 % cream resulted in an 85 % clearance in a series of children with flat warts compared to 32 % spontaneous clearance in the controls 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 19 \]</u>. Astringent chemicals such as trichloroacetic acid and cantharidin are also frequently used in the office setting. Cantharidin is a chemical derived from the blister beetle, Cantharis vesicatoria . When applied it causes dermal blistering and local necrosis. Responses are variable, and this material can cause scarring or spread of warts around the index, treated lesion. Podophyllin, topical 5 % 5-fluorouracil, and intralesional bleomycin are other topical therapies that have varying degrees of antimitotic effect; however, they tend to be more beneficial for mucosal lesions and exophytic warts.

【2】Destructive techniques, such as curettage, electrodesiccation, laser therapy, photodynamic therapy, or cryotherapy using liquid nitrogen, have all been utilized with good results. Nonetheless, destructive techniques are considered second-line therapy as they carry the risk of scar formation and recurrence in or around the treatment site. This is especially true for smaller, less exophytic warts, such as verruca plana. Prolonged occlusive duct tape treatment followed by periodic manual debridement has been shown to be superior or at least comparable to cryotherapy for common warts but has not been reported for flat warts 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 20 \]</u>.

【3】Many laser therapies have been employed. The carbon dioxide (CO 2 ) laser emits an infrared light emission (10,600 nm) that causes a nonselective thermal tissue destruction; the lost skin then heals by secondary intent 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 21 \]</u>. The erbium:yttrium/aluminum/garnet (Er:YAG) emits an infrared light emission (2,940 nm) which is absorbed more efficiently by epidermal water, thus allowing for a more precise ablation and a smaller zone of thermal damage than the CO 2 laser 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 22 \]</u>. No randomized studies on the efficacy of laser therapy for flat warts have been published. Infectious hazards have also been demonstrated for both laser and electrocoagulation, as HPV DNA has been identified in the vaporized laser plume 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 23 \]</u>. Other laser therapies such as pulse dye laser have been used to selectively destroy the dilated capillaries within the warts, producing less pain and scarring than CO 2 laser. This technique has been utilized more for flat warts in children and for facial lesions in all ages due to a preferable safety profile 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 24 \]</u>.

【4】Contact immunotherapy can be an effective treatment. Dinitrochlorobenzene diphenylcyclopropenone or squaric acid have been used as non-mutagenic sensitizers eliciting a contact allergy that theoretically concomitantly heightens the immune response against the virus. Intralesional immunotherapy has little role in flat warts due to their thin nature. A topical immune response modifier, imiquimod, has been FDA approved for external anogenital warts. Imiquimod has been shown to interact with Toll-like receptors 7 and 8, resulting in activation of cytokine secretion from monocytes/macrophages (including α-interferon, interleukin-12, and TNF-α), as well as stimulation of antigen-presenting dendritic cells 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 , 25 \]</u>. No randomized controlled studies have been performed with imiquimod cream at any of the available concentrations (5, 3.75, and 2.5 %) for the management of flat warts. Nonetheless, imiquimod has been widely utilized in children and for facial flat warts in all ages as it generally elicits less discomfort compared to many of the other available treatments. In 2006, the FDA approved an ointment extract of green tea ( Camellia sinensis ) containing 15 % sinecatechins for treatment of genital warts. No studies have been published to date regarding efficacy in flat warts, but it may well represent a novel topical approach for recalcitrant lesions 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 26 \]</u>.

【5】Systemic therapies including garlic supplements ( Allium sativum ) have been shown to inhibit cellular proliferation of virally infected cells 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 27 \]</u>. Oral cimetidine (20–40 mg/kg/day) and oral zinc sulfate supplementation (10 mg/kg/day) have been used in an attempt to enhance cell-mediated immunity 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 28 , 29 \]</u>. Systemic retinoids, both isotretinoin and acitretin, have been used for extensive flat warts. In immunocompromised patients (both EDV and HIV populations), systemic and 1–3 % topical cidofovir, an antiviral that inhibits DNA synthesis, has been used effectively 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 30 \]</u>.

【6】A combination of therapies is often pursued due to the frequent resilience of warts. There is no single gold standard wart treatment. The specific treatment regimen should be individualized to the needs and desires of the patient and subsequently altered or modified based upon the clinical response obtained. With the exception of topical tretinoin, none of the typical repertoire of topical or systemic acne interventions would benefit flat warts.

【48】Abstract

【49】Molluscum contagiosum is a benign cutaneous and mucosal viral infection manifested by dome-shaped flat-topped papules with occasional nodules. Molluscum contagiosum can be seen at any age but predominantly affects children. Molluscum lesions are spread by direct skin to skin contact with fomites, and fomite facilitators can include shaving, tattoos, electrolysis, and bath towels. The incubation period is quite variable, while most commonly ranging from 2 to 7 weeks, in some case, the latency period can be as long as 6 months after exposure. So the process of identifying initial infection can be difficult. Molluscum may be spread through sexual contact as in more commonly seen in young adults and individuals with decreased immunity, including human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) or acquired immune deficiency syndrome (AIDS) or those receiving immunosuppressive therapy. Molluscum contagiosum in neonates and infants is rare, presumably as a result of maternal antibodies.

【50】12.1 Introduction
-----------------

Molluscum contagiosum can be seen at any age but predominantly affects children. Molluscum lesions are spread by direct skin to skin contact with fomites, and fomite facilitators can include shaving, tattoos, electrolysis, and bath towels. 【52】12.2 Background
---------------

【53】Molluscum contagiosum is caused by the molluscum contagiosum virus, the sole member of the genus Molluscipoxvirus. It is a large double-stranded deoxyribonucleic acid virus constructed of a 190-kbp genome that encodes 163 proteins. Most of the proteins encoded by the molluscum genome do not illicit a virus–host interaction, differentiating it from another virus in the poxvirus family, variola, the causative agent of smallpox. Research in molluscum–host interactions is needed but has been hindered by the inability to grow molluscum contagiosum virus in tissue culture cells or animal models 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 , 4 \]</u>.

【54】The transmission through water and swimming pools remains controversial. It is unclear if transmission is due to swimming in contaminated water versus fomites used during swimming activities, including toys, kickboards, or towels 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 \]</u>. The Center for Disease Control and Prevention recommends children with molluscum to cover all visible lesions with watertight bandages and to dispose of all bandages at home. The Center for Disease Control and Prevention also recommends “no sharing of toys, equipment or kickboards during swimming activities. Individuals with open sores should not go into swimming pools 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 5 \]</u>.” The American Academy of Pediatrics does not restrict children with molluscum contagiosum from attending day care, school, or swimming in public pools 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 6 \]</u>.

【55】12.3 Clinical Presentation
--------------------------

【56】Characteristic molluscoid lesions are pearly, flesh- to pink-colored dome-shaped papules that can be translucent ranging in size from 2 to 8 mm usually with a distinct white annular area in the center. Lesions can be umbilicated but this finding is not necessary for diagnosis . Occasionally lesions may be much larger, up to several centimeters termed “giant molluscum.” Significant erythema is common as a reactive eczematous dermatitis that is usually local but may generalize similar to a dermatophytid eruption. Rarely bacterial superinfection can occur with abscess formation. Most individuals present with more than 15 lesions in common areas like axilla, groin, popliteal fossa, genitals, and perianal due to rubbing, friction, and moisture. It is not uncommon to see ill-defined areas of erythematous patches and plaques surrounding molluscoid lesions known as “molluscum dermatitis.” Autoinoculation from scratching pruritic skin spreads the virus to other areas of the body. Lesions can be seen in linear distribution (koebnerization) due to scratching and trauma 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 \]</u>.

【58】Spontaneous resolution usually occurs but timing can vary. Significant erythema can be an indication of host immune response. The majority of infections clear within 6–12 months, but some cases can take years for complete clearance. Children with atopic dermatitis and those who are immunosuppressed have more widespread disease and a prolonged course 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 7 \]</u>.

【59】12.4 Work-Up
------------

【60】Molluscum contagiosum is a clinical diagnosis requiring little to no work-up. Differential diagnosis includes warts (both flat and common), keratosis pilaris, xanthomas, and adnexal tumors 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 8 \]</u>. Wright and Giemsa stains of cells from the core show intracytoplasmic basophilic bodies. Electron microscopy reveals typical poxvirus particles. Dermoscopy can visualize specific characteristic vascular patterns 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 9 \]</u>. Biopsy may be necessary when the diagnosis is unclear, revealing large intracytoplasmic basophilic bodies that push the host nucleus to the periphery, giving a signet ring appearance to the superficial epidermal cells. Real-time polymerase chain reaction is available for homologous p43k and MC080R genes but rarely used 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 10 \]</u>. Bacterial cultures may be considered for lesions with signs and symptoms of secondary bacterial infections.

【61】12.5 Treatment
--------------

【62】Treatment options include observation, destructive methods, and immune modulating modalities. Observation is a reasonable option since spontaneous resolution is common but due to cosmetic impact, pruritus, and concerns of others, teachers, school nurses, and other parents, treatment is often requested 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 , 2 \]</u>.

【63】Destructive methods include cantharidin, curettage, cryotherapy, tape stripping, topical tretinoin cream, 5–10 % potassium hydroxide and keratolytics such as salicylic acid and alpha hydroxyl acid, and pulse dye laser. 【2】**GENE THERAPY**

【3】The field of gene therapy as a method of treating neoplasms and other disorders has been making slow progress over the past few decades. Gene therapy approaches have been applied in preliminary experiments to endocrine tumors such as pitu-itary and thyroid tumors 通用删除6(英):<u>\[57-60\]</u>. A common strategy in gene therapy is to use adenoviral vectors with specific promotors to express selectively marker genes or toxic genes in tissues of interest. The herpes simplex virus thymidine kinase gene has been used to induce cytotoxicity in pituitary adenoma cells fol-lowing the administration of ganciclovir 通用删除6(英):<u>\[57\]</u>. In other studies， the POMC promotor has been used in gene therapy strategies for treatment of pituitary tumors causing adrenocorticotropic hormone(ACTH)-dependent Cushing’s syndrome 通用删除6(英):<u>\[57\]</u>.Other investigators have used adenoviral β-galactosidase expression driven by human cytomegalovirus promotor or the human pro-lactin gene promotor with stereotaxic delivery in the ovine pitu-itary to produce cell-type-specific expression of an adenoviral transgene in mixed populations of the intact pituitary gland 通用删除6(英):<u>\[58\]</u>.

【4】Anaplastic thyroid carcinomas are lethal endocrine cancers without effective means of treatment. Investigators have recently used adenovirus-mediated wild-type p53 gene therapy with a replication-deficientrecombinantadenovirus vector， which has led to a dose-dependent killing of normal and carcinoma cells， with more effective killing of the cancer cells 通用删除6(英):<u>\[60\]</u>. As new methods of gene delivery are developed， gene therapy should become an important tool in treating highly lethal endocrine cancers such as anaplastic thyroid and adrenal cortical cancers.

Because human ES cells can proliferate indefinitely and differentiate into multiple tissue types， these cells could potentially provide an unlimited supply of tissues for human transplantation including islet cell transplantation. The recent studies with mesenchymal stem cells derived from adult bone marrow 通用删除6(英):<u>\[62\]</u> and neural stem cells derived from adult mouse brain 通用删除6(英):<u>\[63\]</u> are promising areas of exploration， especially given the close relationship between the neural and endocrine systems.

【6】In summary， the many recent advances elucidating thepath-ogenesis of endocrine tumors and the development of new tech-nological advances such as high-throughout RNA expression profiling， proteomics， and RNA interference should rapidly increase our knowledge of endocrine tumor pathogenesis.New diagnostic and treatment modalities including new pharmaco-logic agents and gene therapy approaches are emerging from these exciting advances for the treatment of a wide spectrum of endocrine disorders.

【119】开头批量删除-1:<u>**Approach to the Diagnosis**</u>

【120】开头批量删除-1:<u>Obviously， the workup of abnormal facies will depend on what disease is suggested by the facial appearance com-bined with other abnormalities of the physical and neu-rologic examination. A careful history will be helpful in many cases.</u>

【121】开头批量删除-1:<u>**FAILURE TO THRIVE**</u>

【122】开头批量删除-1:<u>Failure to thrive is germane to the pediatric patient who is not growing adequately or fails to gain weight and appears emaciated. The physiologic model of intake， absorption， transport， and utilization will help develop a differential diagnosis.</u>

【123】开头批量删除-1:<u>Intake： Intake of food may be impaired by social condi-tions of poverty， malnutrition， and child abuse. It may also be impaired by chronic anxiety and depression or other psychiatric disorders. Finally， the patient may not eat because of a neurologic disorder such as microceph-aly， hydrocephalus， cerebral palsy， or other disorders associated with mental retardation .</u>

【124】开头批量删除-1:<u>Absorption： Absorption of food may be impaired by mal-absorption syndrome and fibrocystic disease.</u>

【125】开头批量删除-1:<u>Transport： This topic brings to mind chronic anemia and congenital heart disease especially when associated with hypoxemia.</u>

【126】开头批量删除-1:<u>**Utilization： Utilization of food is impaired in diabetes mellitus， hypothyroidism， pituitary insufficiency， galac-tosemia， and uremia.**</u>

【127】开头批量删除-1:<u>Several chronic infectious diseases are associated with failure to thrive. The child may also come from an abnor-mal gestation where the mother suffered alcoholism， drug abuse， or chronic illness.</u>

【128】开头批量删除-1:<u>**Approach to the Diagnosis**</u>

【129】开头批量删除-1:<u>Routine diagnostic workup should include a CBC， sedi-mentation rate， urinalysis， urine culture， chemistry panel， sweat test， stool for quantitative fat， chest x-ray， and elec-trocardiogram (ECG). Bone age x-rays are helpful in deter-mining growth retardation. At this point， it is helpful to consult a pediatrician before ordering expensive diagnostic tests. When studies are negative， consider constitutional growth delay as the cause.</u>

【3】“How frightening!”you respond. Regina nods vigorously.

【4】“Who are the they'that are plotting this against you?” you ask with genuine concern.

“The FBI. They have been following me for years. I moved three times and they kept finding me again. Then I protected myself in self-defense and they threw me in here. It’s been getting worse too. You know， I work in the kitchen， and I re-alized that the other women are sending secret messages to the guards through little wires in the walls. They think I can’t tell， but I can. 【0】lot of women here. Has some-thing specific happened that makes you say that?”

Regina lets out a deep sigh， “Well， yeah， a lot of things to tell you the truth.”|删除换行|“That sounds really frustrating. Can you tell me more about it?”

【2】Regina hesitates but continues.“The guards have cameras everywhere. They are plotting to kill me. They've been planning this for years. They put me in prison because they knew I was catching on to it.

【3】“How frightening!”you respond. Regina nods vigorously.

【4】“Who are the they'that are plotting this against you?” you ask with genuine concern.

“The FBI. They have been following me for years. I moved three times and they kept finding me again. Then I protected myself in self-defense and they threw me in here. It’s been getting worse too. You know， I work in the kitchen， and I re-alized that the other women are sending secret messages to the guards through little wires in the walls. They think I can’t tell， but I can. The only person I have been able to trust is my roommate， but they are moving her out， I’m sure because they couldn’t flip her. Poor thing. I hope they haven't tortured her.”|删除换行|“It sounds like this has been going on for a long time. Have you ever told anyone else about this?”|删除换行|“Ha! I tried to tell my lawyer but I could never get him to call me back. I think they had infiltrated his office anyway. I couldn’t leave my house because they were everywhere， so I lost my job. Did some work from home， but that doesn’t pay too well. Lost touch with my family a while back.”|删除换行|“Help me understand what happened. Why are you here?" you ask.

“Told you， the FBI. They know I’m hot. I’m sent by God and they locked me up to keep me from spilling the beans.”|删除换行|“What beans?" you ask.

【7】“You know I’m sent to let everyone know the world is coming to an end and you better smoke pot now or forever hold your peace." Regina sayswith a dry expression on her face.

【8】You notice that she hasn’t shown any emotion since she came into your office.

【9】“Howaare youffeeling right now， Regina?”you ask.

【10】“I need some pills，” Regina replies. “Gets me through the rough times.”

【11】CCT“Were you taking medication on the outside?”you ask.

【12】“Sometimes，” Regina looks down and squeezes her fingers.

【13】“Did a doctor prescribe medication for you?”you ask.

【14】“Yup， for the Voices you know，” Regina re sponds.

【15】“Are you hearing the voices now?" you ask.

“Oh my god， they’re everywhere. They come through the wires especially in the kitchen. I can’t make them stop.”|删除换行|“What are the voices saying to you， Regina?”you query.

【17】“Stop， stop them before they get you in the back. Be a good servant. Get on God’s side or the Devil will prevail. Stop before you pop. Go slow Joe. How do you know? They know and can get you in the back." Regina sighs heavily.

【18】“Sounds pretty threatening. Is that how it feels?”you say quietly.

【19】“How would you feel with lightening in your back?" Regina asks.

【20】“Regina， how would you like to see a doctor while you’re here and get some medicine so the voices will be quiet?" you ask.

【21】“Maybe so，”Regina states absently.

**“OK， I'm going to make an appointment for you to see the doctor when he's here the next time.I'm|删除0换行|glad you came to talk to me and I’m hoping we can make you feel more comfortable.”

【23】Regina sighs and gets up and opens the door where a guard is standing. “Watch out for the wires. They can hear everything you say，" she says as she turns and walks out.

【0】distinguishing thyroid from parathyroid. In addi-tion， ultrasound-guided FNAB of suspected parathyroid tissue in patients with known hyperparathyroidism has been shown to be an effective technique for localizing the abnormal parathy-roid tissue preoperatively， particularly if the patient has had prior neck surgery 通用删除6(英):<u>\[88-90\]</u>.Parathyroid tissue is also occasion-ally aspirated when it is encompassed by thyroid tissue and presents clinically as a thyroid mass. As in thyroid aspirations， relative contraindications to FNAB of the parathyroid glands include a recent history of anticoagulant therapy or the pres-ence of a bleeding diathesis， due to the risk of hematoma for-mation. When parathyroid cysts are aspirated， water-clearfluid is obtained 通用删除6(英):<u>\[10，91\]</u>. These cysts usually have very few， if any， cells to evaluate. However， the fluid can be sent for chemical analysis； the extremely high level of parathyroid hormone(PTH) will confirm the diagnosis.

It is very important to be able to recognize the normal mor-phology of the parathyroid， particularly to distinguish it from thyroid. This is the first， and frequently critical step， in narrow-ing the differential diagnosis. Immunochemistry for PTH can also be useful in this scenario 通用删除6(英):<u>\[90\]</u>. Aspirates of parathyroid are moderately cellular with small cuboidal cells with scant deli-cate cytoplasm . The chief and clear cells thatpredom-inate in most aspirate smears are cytomorphologically similar with pale blue or clear cytoplasm. Their nuclei are smaller than those of thyroid follicular cells， and they tend to form loose aggregates and rosettelike structures rather than distinet fol-licles. Colloid is not present. The cytoplasm of clear cells is fragile and easily disrupted during smear preparation； as aresult|删除0换行|numerous stripped nuclei may be scattered throughoutthe smear. As with follicular lesions of the thyroid， parathyroid hyperpla-sia， adenoma， and carcinoma cannot reliably be distinguished by FNAB通用删除6(英):<u>\[10，87，92\]</u>.However， offering this differential within the particular clinical contextis usually sufficient to plan defin-itive surgical therapy 通用删除6(英):<u>\[93，94\]</u>. Parathyroid carcinoma should be suspected when aspirates show pronounced cellularity， in-creased numbers of single cells with marked cellular anaplasia， and necrosis 通用删除6(英):<u>\[95，96\]</u>.However， the definitive diagnosis of carci-noma rests on irrefutable histologic evidence of local invasion or metastasis.

【2】Molecular diagnostic techniques may soon prove useful in refining these distinctions. LOH has already been noted in para-thyroid adenomas on chromosomes lp， 11q， and 13q通用删除6(英):<u>\[12，97-99\]</u>， and in parathyroid hyperplasia on chromosomes 2，7p，and18q通用删除6(英):<u>\[100\]</u>.

【3】**ADRENAI**

【4】The primary indication for FNAB of an adrenal gland is the presence of aradiologically detected mass thatis clinically sus-picious for malignancy. Frequently， adrenal lesions are noted incidentally on an abdominal CT scan performed for an unre-lated reason. Suspicious lesions are usually solid and >2 cm. Relative contraindications include a recent history of antico-agulant therapy or the presence of a bleeding diathesis， due to the risk of hematoma formation.One absolute contraindication is suspicion of pheochromocytoma， due to the riskofcatechola-mine crisis and/or fatal hemorrhagic complications. Still， un-suspected pheochromocytomas are usually aspirated without incident. The sensitivity and specificity of FNAB of the adrenal gland for the diagnosis of malignancy are both>90%通用删除6(英):<u>\[101-103\]</u>.

【5】Once an adrenal mass is identified，FNAB is commonly used to determine if the patient has a primary adrenal cortical lesion or a metastasis. Metastatic disease is one of the most frequent diagnoses encountered in aspiration of adrenal glands. Distin-guishing primary from metastatic diseaseis usually straightfor-ward， especially if the primary disease is known and histology or cytology is available for review. At times， however， it can be difficult to differentiate a highly dysplastic adrenal cortical carcinoma from some metastatic lesions based on cytomorphol-ogy alone. Another pitfall occurs if the stripped nuclei of nor-mal adrenal gland or cortical lesions are abundant. This pattern can be misinterpreted as small cellearcinoma. In aspirate smears， the recognition of cell molding， individual cell necrosis， and lack of microvesicular background supportadiagnosis of meta-static small cell carcinoma.

【6】When the mass isidentified as primary adrenal cortical lesion， radiologic and clinical information must be integrated with cyto-morphology. Adrenal corticalcells aretypically polygonal，clus-tering in small groups or cords with central round to oval nuclei. Occasional endocrine atypia manifests as enlarged，hyperchro-matic nuclei and morula formation 通用删除6(英):<u>\[103-105\]</u>. The amount of cytoplasm varies within the different zones of the cortex. Corti-cal cells from the zona glomerulosa and fasiculata tend to have delicate vacuolated， clear cytoplasm with stripped nuclei， while cells from the zona reticularis are more compact with granular cytoplasm， often with lipofuscin pigment .

【7】通用删除16(英):<u>Figure 17Adrenal cortical lesion. Aspirates from cortical lesions， both hyperplasia and neoplasms， are often indistinct from aspirates of normal adrenal. Aspirates are usually highly cellular with cortical cells dispersed singly or in small groups. The cells have moderate amounts of vacuolated cytoplasm that is easily stripped from their nuclei； the latter appear scattered throughout the background.Diff-Quik stain， original magnification ×200.</u>

【10】As with thyroid and parathyroid， the differentiation of adre-nal hyperplasia from adenoma and carcinoma is very difficult， if notimpossible， by FNAB. Adrenal cortical hyperplasia typi-cally presents as a cellular specimen with unremarkable adre-nal cortical cells dispersed singly or in groups with scattered stripped nuclei. The dispersed cytoplasm lends a microves-icular appearance to the smear background as a result of the pres-ence of lipids. Mitotic figures and necrotic debris are absent. Well circumscribed or encapsulated nodules that are aspirated and composed of adrenal cortical cells typically represent a neoplasm. Adenomas are cytologically identical in appearance to aspirates from normal and hyperplastic adrenal glands . Although one can use radiologic data as a clue to the bio-logic behavior， cytologic evidence from carcinoma that is wor-risome include the presence of necrosis， diffuse cytologic atypia， and mitoses， especially atypical forms 通用删除6(英):<u>\[106\]</u>. These lesions typically must be excised surgically for a more comprehensive assessment

【11】Primary lesions of the adrenal medulla， pheochromocyto-mas， are rarely aspirated， often because the clinical presenta-tion in conjunction with laboratory studies (increased vanillyl-mandelic acid and catecholamines in urine and/or plasma) and

(B) Pheochromocytoma. Moderate to large neoplastic cells with abundant cytoplasm， large nuclei with granular chromatin and large nucleoli. Papanicolaou stain， original magnification x400.</u>|删除换行|include other pediatric small round blue cell tumors such as Wilms'tumor， primitive neuroectodermal tumor，Ewing’s sar-coma， rhabdomyosarcoma， as well as malignant lymphomas. Immunochemistry (neuron-specific enolase \[NSE\]，S100，neu-rofilaments，leukocyte common antigen \[LCA\]， actin， desmin) as well as DNA ploidy are helpful. Interphase FISH for 1 pdele-tion and N-myc amplification for prognosis can also be assessed if enough sample is obtained. The appearance of ganglion cells within aspirates shifts the differential diagnosis toward ganglio-neuroblastoma and gang lioneuroma 通用删除6(英):<u>\[109\]</u>. Ganglion cells are characteristically large cells with moderate amounts of cyto-plasm； usually coarse， granular chromatin with distinet nucleoli； and occasional multinucleation . Ganglioneuroblas-tomas show ganglion cells dispersed singly or in small foci throug h-out the neuroblastomatous component， whereas aspirates of ganglioneuromas have a mixed population of mature ganglion cells， spindle cells and matrix of Schwannian origin， and colla-gen. As the diagnosis of ganglioneuroma relies on the absence

【14】MELAN A AND &-INHIBIN Ancillary testing is some-what limited at this time for adrenal aspirates. The most useful markers in identifying a tumor of adrenal origin (or excluding a metastatic tumor) are melan A103 and u-inhibin 通用删除6(英):<u>\[110，111\]</u>. Although these markers are not entirely specific for adrenal tissue， they are usually quite helpful，particularly when used in tandem.

【15】LOH FOR ADRENAL CORTICALLESIONS Itisusually impossible to reliably separate adrenal cortical hyperplasia， ade-noma， and carcinoma solely based on morphology， sometimes even in the excised surgical specimen. Unfortunately，a dependa-bly characteristic protein marker is not yet available to make this distinction，butLOHhas proven to be contributory in many cases.

LOH associated with adrenal cortical carcinoma has been identified on chromosomes lp， 2p，3p，and 17p， andLOHiden-|删除0换行|tified on chromosomes 9p 通用删除11(英):<u>(p16)</u> and 11q is more common in carcinoma than in adenoma \[12，1121. Of note， LOH studies performed on FNAB material obtained from primarily meta-static lesions produced reliable results， which were shown to correlate precisely with the surgical material from the primary tumor 通用删除6(英):<u>\[112\]</u>.

【17】LOH IN PHEOCHROMOCYTOMA Similarly， in pheo-chromocytoma，itis often impossible to determine malignancy based on morphology alone， sometimes even in the excised surgical specimen. Again， a dependably characteristic protein marker is not yet available to make this distinction. LOH has been noted in pheochromocytomas on chromosomes lp and22q通用删除6(英):<u>\[12\]</u>， but to our knowledge there have been no markers that can differentiate benign from malignant pheochromocytomas as yet.

【18】**MARKERS OF PROGNOSIS IN NEUROBLASTOMATOUS**

【19】TUMORSIn neuroblatomatous tumors， ancillary testing for DNA ploidy analysis and for N-myc amplification and lp deletion is quite helpful in determining prognosis and predict-ing response to therapy. Multiple methodologies are available for performing this testing， most recently including interphase FISH\[1131.

【20】**SUMMARY**

【21】FNAB is a simple， rapid， accurate， economical， and mini-mally invasive technique for the diagnosis of endocrine lesions. Good technical training and adequate experience in obtaining and preparing samples are critical to the overall effectiveness of the procedure. With adequate knowledge of the morphol-ogy， supplemented by knowledge access to appropriate ancil-lary techniques， many diagnoses can be made without resorting to surgical intervention. As technology continues to evolve rapidly， and more molecular and proteomic markers are iden-tified， ancillary techniques will become widely available and many of the current ambiguities in the diagnosis of the most common endocrine lesions will be clarified. The specific infor-mation obtained from the FNAB specimen will continue to save more and more patients from invasive， costly procedures. The combined use of FNAB and molecular diag nostics has a great potential to improve patient care.

Their nuclei are smaller than those of thyroid follicular cells， and they tend to form loose aggregates and rosettelike structures rather than distinet fol-licles. Colloid is not present. The cytoplasm of clear cells is fragile and easily disrupted during smear preparation； as aresult|删除0换行|numerous stripped nuclei may be scattered throughoutthe smear. As with follicular lesions of the thyroid， parathyroid hyperpla-sia， adenoma， and carcinoma cannot reliably be distinguished by FNAB通用删除6(英):<u>\[10，87，92\]</u>.However， offering this differential within the particular clinical contextis usually sufficient to plan defin-itive surgical therapy 通用删除6(英):<u>\[93，94\]</u>. Parathyroid carcinoma should be suspected when aspirates show pronounced cellularity， in-creased numbers of single cells with marked cellular anaplasia， and necrosis 通用删除6(英):<u>\[95，96\]</u>.However， the definitive diagnosis of carci-noma rests on irrefutable histologic evidence of local invasion or metastasis.

【2】Molecular diagnostic techniques may soon prove useful in refining these distinctions. LOH has already been noted in para-thyroid adenomas on chromosomes lp， 11q， and 13q通用删除6(英):<u>\[12，97-99\]</u>， and in parathyroid hyperplasia on chromosomes 2，7p，and18q通用删除6(英):<u>\[100\]</u>.

【3】**ADRENAI**

【4】The primary indication for FNAB of an adrenal gland is the presence of aradiologically detected mass thatis clinically sus-picious for malignancy. Frequently， adrenal lesions are noted incidentally on an abdominal CT scan performed for an unre-lated reason. Suspicious lesions are usually solid and >2 cm. Relative contraindications include a recent history of antico-agulant therapy or the presence of a bleeding diathesis， due to the risk of hematoma formation.One absolute contraindication is suspicion of pheochromocytoma， due to the riskofcatechola-mine crisis and/or fatal hemorrhagic complications. Still， un-suspected pheochromocytomas are usually aspirated without incident. The sensitivity and specificity of FNAB of the adrenal gland for the diagnosis of malignancy are both>90%通用删除6(英):<u>\[101-103\]</u>.

【5】Once an adrenal mass is identified，FNAB is commonly used to determine if the patient has a primary adrenal cortical lesion or a metastasis. Metastatic disease is one of the most frequent diagnoses encountered in aspiration of adrenal glands. Distin-guishing primary from metastatic diseaseis usually straightfor-ward， especially if the primary disease is known and histology or cytology is available for review. At times， however， it can be difficult to differentiate a highly dysplastic adrenal cortical carcinoma from some metastatic lesions based on cytomorphol-ogy alone. Another pitfall occurs if the stripped nuclei of nor-mal adrenal gland or cortical lesions are abundant. This pattern can be misinterpreted as small cellearcinoma. In aspirate smears， the recognition of cell molding， individual cell necrosis， and lack of microvesicular background supportadiagnosis of meta-static small cell carcinoma.

【6】When the mass isidentified as primary adrenal cortical lesion， radiologic and clinical information must be integrated with cyto-morphology. Adrenal corticalcells aretypically polygonal，clus-tering in small groups or cords with central round to oval nuclei. Occasional endocrine atypia manifests as enlarged，hyperchro-matic nuclei and morula formation 通用删除6(英):<u>\[103-105\]</u>. The amount of cytoplasm varies within the different zones of the cortex. Corti-cal cells from the zona glomerulosa and fasiculata tend to have delicate vacuolated， clear cytoplasm with stripped nuclei， while cells from the zona reticularis are more compact with granular cytoplasm， often with lipofuscin pigment .

Well circumscribed or encapsulated nodules that are aspirated and composed of adrenal cortical cells typically represent a neoplasm. Adenomas are cytologically identical in appearance to aspirates from normal and hyperplastic adrenal glands . Multiple methodologies are available for performing this testing， most recently including interphase FISH\[1131.

【20】**SUMMARY**

【21】FNAB is a simple， rapid， accurate， economical， and mini-mally invasive technique for the diagnosis of endocrine lesions. Good technical training and adequate experience in obtaining and preparing samples are critical to the overall effectiveness of the procedure. With adequate knowledge of the morphol-ogy， supplemented by knowledge access to appropriate ancil-lary techniques， many diagnoses can be made without resorting to surgical intervention. As technology continues to evolve rapidly， and more molecular and proteomic markers are iden-tified， ancillary techniques will become widely available and many of the current ambiguities in the diagnosis of the most common endocrine lesions will be clarified. The specific infor-mation obtained from the FNAB specimen will continue to save more and more patients from invasive， costly procedures. The combined use of FNAB and molecular diag nostics has a great potential to improve patient care.

结尾批量删除-1:<u>Cal25 This is an abbreviation for cancer antigen 125， which is a mucinous glycoprotein produced by the MUC16 gene.
